DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_LEVIAT.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_leviat_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    'USER_ACCOUNTS' AS table_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_records,
    COUNT_IF(expiration_date IS NULL) AS null_expiration_date,
    COUNT_IF(last_logon_date IS NULL) AS null_last_logon
FROM dim_leviat_users
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'SECURITY_EVENTS',
    COUNT(*),
    COUNT_IF(event_timestamp IS NULL),
    COUNT_IF(username IS NULL)
FROM fact_leviat_security_events;

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW QUALYS_CONSOLIDATED AS
SELECT 
    h.HOST_OS,
    h.INSCOPE,
    h.LAST_SCAN_DATE,
    v.QID,
    v.VULN_TYPE,
    v.SEVERITY_LEVEL,
    v.TITLE,
    v.CATEGORY,
    v.CVE_ID,
    v.CVSS_V3_BASE,
    v.PATCHABLE,
    v.EXPLOITABLE,
    f.SCAN_DATE,
    f.RISK_SCORE
FROM FACT_VULN_SCAN f
JOIN DIM_VULNERABILITY v ON f.VULN_KEY = v.VULN_KEY
JOIN DIM_HOST h ON f.HOST_KEY = h.HOST_KEY;

DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.SYMANTEC_.name: SYMANTEC_CONSOLIDATED
DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.SYMANTEC_.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.SYMANTEC_CONSOLIDATED AS

-- First, join COMPUTERS and DEVICE tables on computer name to get complete device information
WITH device_consolidated AS (
    SELECT 
        -- Primary identifier fields
        c.COMPUTER_NAME,
        c.DEVICE_DOMAIN,
        c.GROUP_NAME,
        COALESCE(c.GROUP_UPPER, d.GROUP_NAME) AS GROUP_HIERARCHY,
        
        -- Device information
        COALESCE(c.DEVICE_DESCRIPTION, d.DEVICE_DESCRIPTION) AS DEVICE_DESCRIPTION,
        TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(COALESCE(c.DEVICE_CREATION_TIME, d.DEVICE_CREATION_TIME)) AS DEVICE_CREATION_TIME,
        TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(COALESCE(c.DEVICE_LAST_UPDATE_TIME, d.DEVICE_LAST_UPDATE_TIME)) AS DEVICE_LAST_UPDATE_TIME,
        COALESCE(c.DEVICE_SECURITY_STATUS, d.DEVICE_SECURITY_STATUS) AS DEVICE_SECURITY_STATUS,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.DEVICE_RESTART_REQUIRED IS NOT NULL THEN c.DEVICE_RESTART_REQUIRED
            WHEN d.DEVICE_RESTART_REQUIRED = 'True' THEN TRUE
            WHEN d.DEVICE_RESTART_REQUIRED = 'False' THEN FALSE
            ELSE NULL
        END AS DEVICE_RESTART_REQUIRED,
        
        -- Client information
        COALESCE(c.CLIENT_TYPE, d.CLIENT_TYPE) AS CLIENT_TYPE,
        COALESCE(c.CLIENT_VERSION, d.CLIENT_VERSION) AS CLIENT_VERSION,
        COALESCE(c.MANAGED_BY, d.MANAGED_BY) AS MANAGED_BY,
        c.SYMANTEC_OPCO,
        c.SYMANTEC_VERSIONS_INDEX,
        c.SYMANTECLASTCLIENTUPDATE,
        c.SYMANTECCLIENTRELEASEDATE,
        
        -- User information
        COALESCE(c.LOGIN_USER, d.LOGIN_USER) AS LOGIN_USER,
        
        -- Operating system information
        COALESCE(c.OPERATING_SYSTEM, d.OPERATING_SYSTEM) AS OPERATING_SYSTEM,
        COALESCE(c.OPERATING_SYSTEM_LANGUAGE, d.OPERATING_SYSTEM_LANGUAGE) AS OPERATING_SYSTEM_LANGUAGE,
        COALESCE(c.OPERATING_SYSTEM_VERSION, d.OPERATING_SYSTEM_VERSION) AS OPERATING_SYSTEM_VERSION,
        COALESCE(c.TIME_ZONE_OFFSET, d.TIME_ZONE_OFFSET) AS TIME_ZONE_OFFSET,
        
        -- Hardware information
        CASE 
            WHEN c.VIRTUAL_MACHINE IS NOT NULL THEN c.VIRTUAL_MACHINE
            WHEN d.VIRTUAL_MACHINE = 'True' THEN TRUE
            WHEN d.VIRTUAL_MACHINE = 'False' THEN FALSE
            ELSE NULL
        END AS VIRTUAL_MACHINE,
        COALESCE(c.DEVICE_MODEL_VENDOR, d.DEVICE_MODEL_VENDOR) AS DEVICE_MODEL_VENDOR,
        COALESCE(c.BIOS_INFORMATION, d.BIOS_INFORMATION) AS BIOS_INFORMATION,
        COALESCE(c.CPU_TYPE, d.CPU_TYPE) AS CPU_TYPE,
        COALESCE(c.CPU_CLOCK::NUMBER, TRY_TO_NUMBER(d.CPU_CLOCK)) AS CPU_CLOCK,
        COALESCE(c.TOTAL_MEMORY_MB::NUMBER, TRY_TO_NUMBER(d.TOTAL_MEMORY_MB)) AS TOTAL_MEMORY_MB,
        COALESCE(c.FREE_DISK_MB::NUMBER, TRY_TO_NUMBER(d.FREE_DISK_MB)) AS FREE_DISK_MB,
        COALESCE(c.TOTAL_DISK_MB::NUMBER, TRY_TO_NUMBER(d.TOTAL_DISK_MB)) AS TOTAL_DISK_MB,
        
        -- Network information
        COALESCE(c.DNS_ADDRESSES, d.DNS_ADDRESSES) AS DNS_ADDRESSES,
        COALESCE(c.MAC_ADDRESSES, d.MAC_ADDRESSES) AS MAC_ADDRESSES,
        COALESCE(c.IPV4_ADDRESSES, d.IPV4_ADDRESSES) AS IPV4_ADDRESSES,
        COALESCE(c.SUBNET_MASK, d.SUBNET_MASK) AS SUBNET_MASK,
        COALESCE(c.IPV6_ADDRESSES, d.IPV6_ADDRESSES) AS IPV6_ADDRESSES,
        
        -- Protection status
        COALESCE(c.MALWARE_PROTECTION, d.MALWARE_PROTECTION) AS MALWARE_PROTECTION,
        COALESCE(c.MALWARE_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION, d.MALWARE_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION) AS MALWARE_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION,
        COALESCE(c.MALWARE_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION, d.MALWARE_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION) AS MALWARE_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION,
        TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(COALESCE(c.MALWARE_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME, d.MALWARE_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME)) AS MALWARE_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
        CASE 
            WHEN c.HAS_UNRESOLVED_THREATS IS NOT NULL THEN c.HAS_UNRESOLVED_THREATS
            WHEN d.HAS_UNRESOLVED_THREATS = 'True' THEN TRUE
            WHEN d.HAS_UNRESOLVED_THREATS = 'False' THEN FALSE
            ELSE NULL
        END AS HAS_UNRESOLVED_THREATS,
        TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(c.LAST_VIRUS_DETECTION_TIME) AS LAST_VIRUS_DETECTION_TIME,
        TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(c.LAST_SCAN_TIME) AS LAST_SCAN_TIME,
        
        -- Security features
        COALESCE(c.BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS, d.BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_STATUS) AS BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_STATUS,
        COALESCE(c.BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_ENGINE_VERSION, d.BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_ENGINE_VERSION) AS BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_ENGINE_VERSION,
        COALESCE(c.BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_CONTENT_VERSION, d.BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_CONTENT_VERSION) AS BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_CONTENT_VERSION,
        TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(COALESCE(c.BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME, d.BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME)) AS BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
        
        COALESCE(c.EXPLOIT_PROTECTION, d.EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_STATUS) AS EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_STATUS,
        COALESCE(c.EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION, d.EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION) AS EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION,
        COALESCE(c.EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION, d.EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION) AS EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION,
        TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(COALESCE(c.EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME, d.EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME)) AS EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
        
        COALESCE(c.INTRUSION_PREVENTION, d.INTRUSION_PREVENTION) AS INTRUSION_PREVENTION_STATUS,
        COALESCE(c.INTRUSION_PREVENTION_ENGINE_VERSION, d.INTRUSION_PREVENTION_ENGINE_VERSION) AS INTRUSION_PREVENTION_ENGINE_VERSION,
        COALESCE(c.INTRUSION_PREVENTION_CONTENT_VERSION, d.INTRUSION_PREVENTION_CONTENT_VERSION) AS INTRUSION_PREVENTION_CONTENT_VERSION,
        TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(COALESCE(c.INTRUSION_PREVENTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME, d.INTRUSION_PREVENTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME)) AS INTRUSION_PREVENTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
        
        COALESCE(c.BROWSER_PROTECTION, d.BROWSER_PROTECTION_STATUS) AS BROWSER_PROTECTION_STATUS,
        COALESCE(c.BROWSER_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION, d.BROWSER_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION) AS BROWSER_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION,
        COALESCE(c.BROWSER_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION, d.BROWSER_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION) AS BROWSER_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION,
        TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(COALESCE(c.BROWSER_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME, d.BROWSER_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME)) AS BROWSER_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
        
        COALESCE(c.WEB_SECURITY, d.WEB_SECURITY_STATUS) AS WEB_SECURITY_STATUS,
        COALESCE(c.WEB_SECURITY_ENGINE_VERSION, d.WEB_SECURITY_ENGINE_VERSION) AS WEB_SECURITY_ENGINE_VERSION,
        COALESCE(c.WEB_SECURITY_CONTENT_VERSION, d.WEB_SECURITY_CONTENT_VERSION) AS WEB_SECURITY_CONTENT_VERSION,
        TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(COALESCE(c.WEB_SECURITY_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME, d.WEB_SECURITY_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME)) AS WEB_SECURITY_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
        
        COALESCE(c.DEVICE_CONTROL, d.DEVICE_CONTROL_STATUS) AS DEVICE_CONTROL_STATUS,
        COALESCE(c.FIREWALL, d.FIREWALL_STATUS) AS FIREWALL_STATUS,
        COALESCE(c.TDAD, d.TDAD) AS TDAD_STATUS,
        
        COALESCE(c.APP_CONTROL, d.APP_CONTROL_STATUS) AS APP_CONTROL_STATUS,
        COALESCE(c.APP_CONTROL_ENGINE_VERSION, d.APP_CONTROL_ENGINE_VERSION) AS APP_CONTROL_ENGINE_VERSION,
        COALESCE(c.APP_CONTROL_CONTENT_VERSION, d.APP_CONTROL_CONTENT_VERSION) AS APP_CONTROL_CONTENT_VERSION,
        TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(COALESCE(c.APP_CONTROL_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME, d.APP_CONTROL_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME)) AS APP_CONTROL_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
        
        COALESCE(c.EDR, d.EDR_STATUS) AS EDR_STATUS,
        COALESCE(c.EDR_ENGINE_VERSION, d.EDR_ENGINE_VERSION) AS EDR_ENGINE_VERSION,
        COALESCE(c.EDR_CONTENT_VERSION, d.EDR_CONTENT_VERSION) AS EDR_CONTENT_VERSION,
        
        c.HOST_INTEGRITY AS HOST_INTEGRITY_STATUS,
        c.HOST_INTEGRITY_ENGINE_VERSION,
        c.HOST_INTEGRITY_CONTENT_VERSION,
        TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(c.HOST_INTEGRITY_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME) AS HOST_INTEGRITY_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
        
        c.UNITY
    FROM 
        DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.SYMANTEC_COMPUTERS c
    FULL OUTER JOIN 
        DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.SYMANTEC_DEVICE d
    ON 
        c.COMPUTER_NAME = d.COMPUTER_NAME
)

-- Main query that joins device information with threat information
SELECT
    d.*,
    -- Threat aggregation metrics
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.THREAT_NAME) AS TOTAL_UNIQUE_THREATS,
    COUNT(t.THREAT_NAME) AS TOTAL_THREAT_OCCURRENCES,
    MAX(TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(t.DATESEEN)) AS LAST_THREAT_SEEN_DATE,
    MIN(TO_TIMESTAMP_NTZ(t.DATESEEN)) AS FIRST_THREAT_SEEN_DATE,
    -- Create an array of threat information for analysis
    ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(
        'threat_name', t.THREAT_NAME,
        'date_seen', t.DATESEEN,
        'type', t.TYPE,
        'feature_name', t.FEATURE_NAME,
        'file_name', t.FILE_NAME,
        'file_folder', t.FILE_FOLDER,
        'file_product_name', t.FILE_PRODUCT_NAME
    )) AS THREAT_DETAILS
FROM 
    device_consolidated d
LEFT JOIN 
    DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.SYMANTEC_THREATS t
ON 
    d.COMPUTER_NAME = t.DEVICE_NAME
GROUP BY
    d.COMPUTER_NAME, d.DEVICE_DOMAIN, d.GROUP_NAME, d.GROUP_HIERARCHY, d.DEVICE_DESCRIPTION, 
    d.DEVICE_CREATION_TIME, d.DEVICE_LAST_UPDATE_TIME, d.DEVICE_SECURITY_STATUS, 
    d.DEVICE_RESTART_REQUIRED, d.CLIENT_TYPE, d.CLIENT_VERSION, d.MANAGED_BY, 
    d.SYMANTEC_OPCO, d.SYMANTEC_VERSIONS_INDEX, d.SYMANTECLASTCLIENTUPDATE, 
    d.SYMANTECCLIENTRELEASEDATE, d.LOGIN_USER, d.OPERATING_SYSTEM, 
    d.OPERATING_SYSTEM_LANGUAGE, d.OPERATING_SYSTEM_VERSION, d.TIME_ZONE_OFFSET, 
    d.VIRTUAL_MACHINE, d.DEVICE_MODEL_VENDOR, d.BIOS_INFORMATION, d.CPU_TYPE, 
    d.CPU_CLOCK, d.TOTAL_MEMORY_MB, d.FREE_DISK_MB, d.TOTAL_DISK_MB, d.DNS_ADDRESSES, 
    d.MAC_ADDRESSES, d.IPV4_ADDRESSES, d.SUBNET_MASK, d.IPV6_ADDRESSES, 
    d.MALWARE_PROTECTION, d.MALWARE_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION, 
    d.MALWARE_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION, d.MALWARE_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME, 
    d.HAS_UNRESOLVED_THREATS, d.LAST_VIRUS_DETECTION_TIME, d.LAST_SCAN_TIME, 
    d.BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_STATUS, d.BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_ENGINE_VERSION, 
    d.BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_CONTENT_VERSION, d.BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME, 
    d.EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_STATUS, d.EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION, 
    d.EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION, d.EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME, 
    d.INTRUSION_PREVENTION_STATUS, d.INTRUSION_PREVENTION_ENGINE_VERSION, 
    d.INTRUSION_PREVENTION_CONTENT_VERSION, d.INTRUSION_PREVENTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME, 
    d.BROWSER_PROTECTION_STATUS, d.BROWSER_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION, 
    d.BROWSER_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION, d.BROWSER_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME, 
    d.WEB_SECURITY_STATUS, d.WEB_SECURITY_ENGINE_VERSION, d.WEB_SECURITY_CONTENT_VERSION, 
    d.WEB_SECURITY_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME, d.DEVICE_CONTROL_STATUS, d.FIREWALL_STATUS, 
    d.TDAD_STATUS, d.APP_CONTROL_STATUS, d.APP_CONTROL_ENGINE_VERSION, 
    d.APP_CONTROL_CONTENT_VERSION, d.APP_CONTROL_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME, d.EDR_STATUS, 
    d.EDR_ENGINE_VERSION, d.EDR_CONTENT_VERSION, d.HOST_INTEGRITY_STATUS, 
    d.HOST_INTEGRITY_ENGINE_VERSION, d.HOST_INTEGRITY_CONTENT_VERSION, 
    d.HOST_INTEGRITY_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME, d.UNITY;

DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OBJECT.name: VW_OBJECTS_SUMMARY
DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OBJECT.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OBJECTS_SUMMARY AS
SELECT 
    table_catalog     AS environment,
    table_schema      AS schema_name,
    table_name,
    table_type,
    created,
    last_altered
FROM 
    information_schema.tables
WHERE 
    table_schema = 'SECURITY_ANALYTICS';

DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_PASSWO.name: VW_PASSWORD_HEALTH
DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_PASSWO.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_password_health AS
SELECT 
    opco,
    COUNT_IF(password_age_days > 90) AS expired_passwords,
    COUNT_IF(password_never_expires) AS never_expire_count
FROM dim_leviat_users
GROUP BY opco;

DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.V_SNOWFLA.name: V_SNOWFLAKE_EQUIVALENTS
DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.V_SNOWFLA.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW V_SNOWFLAKE_EQUIVALENTS AS
SELECT 
    SNOWCLI_COMMAND AS "SnowCLI Command",
    NATIVE_EQUIVALENT AS "Native Equivalent",
    IMPLEMENTATION_TYPE AS "Implementation Type",
    EXAMPLE AS "Example",
    CATEGORY AS "Category"
FROM SNOWFLAKE_NATIVE_EQUIVALENTS;

DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_LEVIAT.name: VW_LEVIAT_SECURITY_ALERTS
DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_LEVIAT.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_leviat_security_alerts AS
SELECT
    'LOCKED_ACCOUNT' AS alert_type,
    username,
    'Account is locked out' AS description
FROM dim_leviat_users
WHERE account_is_locked_out = TRUE

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'PASSWORD_EXPIRED',
    username,
    'Password expired >90 days'
FROM dim_leviat_users
WHERE password_age_days > 90

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'INACTIVE_ACCOUNT',
    username,
    'No logon in 90 days'
FROM dim_leviat_users
WHERE last_logon_date < DATEADD(day, -90, CURRENT_DATE())

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'FREQUENT_FAILED_LOGONS',
    username,
    '>5 failed logon attempts'
FROM fact_leviat_security_events
WHERE event_type = 'Failed Logon'
GROUP BY username
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.SE.name: SENTINEL_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.SE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW dev_transformation.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.sentinel_data_quality AS
SELECT 
   COUNT(*) AS total_records,
   COUNT_IF(VERSION_RELEASE_DATE IS NULL) AS missing_version_count,
   COUNT_IF(NOT UPDATE_STATUS) AS outdated_agents,
   COUNT(DISTINCT ENDPOINT_NAME) AS unique_endpoints,
   COUNT(DISTINCT AGENT_VERSION) AS unique_versions,
   MAX(LOAD_TIMESTAMP) AS last_update
FROM dev_transformation.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.sentinel_consolidated;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_ANCON_USER_STATUS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_ancon_user_status AS
SELECT 
    username,
    COALESCE(email_address, 'NO_EMAIL') AS contact,
    disabled,
    account_is_locked_out,
    DATEDIFF('day', last_logon_date, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_since_last_logon,
    password_age_days,
    password_never_expires
FROM dim_ancon_users;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_AV_COMPLIANCE_STATUS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_av_compliance_status AS
SELECT
    o.opco_name,
    o.region,
    f.report_month,
    f.av_health_score,
    f.av_installed_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN f.av_installed_pct >= 0.95 THEN 'COMPLIANT'
        WHEN f.av_installed_pct >= 0.85 THEN 'WARNING'
        ELSE 'NON_COMPLIANT'
    END AS av_install_status
FROM fact_av_health f
JOIN dim_av_opco o ON f.opco_name = o.opco_name;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_BITSIGHT_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_bitsight_data_quality AS
SELECT
    'FINDINGS' AS table_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_records,
    COUNT_IF(last_seen IS NULL) AS null_last_seen,
    COUNT_IF(severity IS NULL) AS null_severity
FROM fact_bitsight_findings;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_DAILY_THREAT_SUMMARY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_daily_threat_summary AS
SELECT
    DATE(threat_date) AS threat_day,
    threat_category,
    COUNT(*) AS threat_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS affected_devices
FROM fact_zscaler_threats
GROUP BY 1,2;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_DEFENDER_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_defender_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    COUNT_IF(last_status_update IS NULL) AS null_status_updates,
    COUNT_IF(device_state IS NULL) AS null_device_states
FROM dim_defender_endpoints;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_SENTINEL_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_sentinel_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(version_release_date IS NULL) AS missing_version_dates,
    COUNT_IF(NOT update_status) AS outdated_agents,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF('day', last_active, CURRENT_DATE()) > 30) AS inactive_devices,
    COUNT(DISTINCT domain) AS unique_domains,
    MAX(load_timestamp) AS last_refreshed
FROM fact_sentinel_endpoints;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_STOCK_REPORT
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_stock_report AS
SELECT 
    computer_name,
    manufacturer,
    model,
    bios_serial_number,
    last_scanned,
    status,
    client_version,
    msi_version
FROM dim_hardware_inventory;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.V_.name: V_PROTECTION_STATUS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.V_.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.V_PROTECTION_STATUS AS
SELECT 
    DEVICE_NAME,
    DEVICE_GROUP,
    OPERATING_SYSTEM,
    MALWARE_PROTECTION,
    BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS,
    EXPLOIT_PROTECTION,
    INTRUSION_PREVENTION,
    BROWSER_PROTECTION,
    WEB_SECURITY,
    FIREWALL,
    EDR,
    HAS_UNRESOLVED_THREATS,
    DEVICE_SECURITY_STATUS,
    LAST_SCAN_TIME
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SYMANTEC_CONSOLIDATED
ORDER BY DEVICE_NAME;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_FARRANS_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_farrans_data_quality AS
SELECT
    'ENDPOINTS' AS table_name,  -- Cambiar 'table' por 'table_name'
    COUNT_IF(ARRAY_SIZE(ip_addresses) = 0) AS no_ip,
    COUNT_IF(os IS NULL) AS null_os
FROM dim_farrans_endpoints
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'HEALTH' AS table_name,     -- Cambiar 'table' por 'table_name'
    COUNT_IF(last_active IS NULL) AS no_ip,
    COUNT_IF(health_status IS NULL) AS null_os
FROM fact_farrans_health;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_MCAFEE_SECURITY_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_mcafee_security_alerts AS
SELECT 
    'NON_COMPLIANT' AS alert_type,
    system_name,
    'Compliance status: ' || compliance_status AS description,
    last_communication
FROM dim_mcafee_endpoints
WHERE compliance_status != 'Compliant'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'OUTDATED_PATCH',
    system_name,
    'Patch version < 5: ' || esp_patch_version,
    last_communication
FROM dim_mcafee_endpoints
WHERE esp_patch_version < 5
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'INACTIVE_ENDPOINT',
    system_name,
    'No communication in 7 days',
    last_communication
FROM dim_mcafee_endpoints
WHERE last_communication < DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_DATE())
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'AGENT_OUTDATED',
    system_name,
    'Agent version outdated: ' || agent_version,
    last_communication
FROM dim_mcafee_endpoints
WHERE SPLIT_PART(agent_version, '.', 1) < 5;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_OS_REMEDIATION_TREND
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_os_remediation_trend AS
SELECT
    os,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', last_fixed) AS fix_month,
    COUNT(*) AS fixes_count
FROM fact_remediation_events
GROUP BY 1, 2;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_SENTINEL_REPORTING
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_sentinel_reporting AS
SELECT * FROM fact_sentinel_endpoints;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_THREAT_INTEL_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_threat_intel_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    'EVENTS' AS table_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_records,
    COUNT_IF(event_date IS NULL) AS null_dates,
    COUNT_IF(takedown_successful IS NULL) AS null_takedown
FROM fact_threat_intel_events
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'SUMMARY',
    COUNT(*),
    COUNT_IF(month_year IS NULL),
    COUNT_IF(total_events IS NULL)
FROM fact_threat_intel_summary;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.TR.name: TRENDMICRO_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.TR.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW dev_transformation.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.trendmicro_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(VERSION_RELEASE_DATE IS NULL) AS missing_version_info,
    COUNT_IF(NOT SEND_POLICY_SUCCESSFUL OR SEND_POLICY_SUCCESSFUL IS NULL) AS policy_deployment_failures,
    COUNT_IF(MAINTENANCE_MODE) AS endpoints_in_maintenance,
    COUNT_IF(UPPER(STATUS) NOT IN ('OK', 'HEALTHY', 'ONLINE')) AS unhealthy_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF(day, LAST_SEEN_DATE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) > 7) AS inactive_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(UPPER(SECURITY_UPDATE_STATUS) != 'UP-TO-DATE') AS security_updates_pending,
    COUNT_IF(UPPER(SOFTWARE_UPDATE_STATUS) != 'UP-TO-DATE') AS software_updates_pending,
    COUNT(DISTINCT GROUP_) AS total_groups,
    COUNT(DISTINCT PLATFORM) AS platform_diversity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT VERSION) AS version_fragmentation,
    MAX(LOAD_TIMESTAMP) AS last_etl_run
FROM dev_transformation.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.trendmicro_consolidated;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_ALERT_ANALYSIS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_alert_analysis AS
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('DAY', created_time) AS alert_day,
    company,
    close_code,
    COUNT(*) AS total_alerts,
    AVG(DATEDIFF('MINUTE', created_time, resolved_time)) AS avg_resolution_min
FROM fact_splunk_alerts
GROUP BY 1,2,3;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_CISCO_AMP_COMPLIANCE
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_CISCO_AMP_compliance AS
SELECT 
    DATE(Last_Seen) AS report_date,
    COUNT_IF(NOT Is_Active) AS inactive_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(Connector_VERSION < '8.0.0') AS outdated_versions
FROM CISCO_AMP_data
GROUP BY report_date;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_DEFENDER_ENDPOINT_STATUS
VW_MCAFEE_COMPLIANCE_STATUS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_mcafee_compliance_status AS
SELECT
    compliance_status,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    AVG(DATEDIFF(day, last_communication, CURRENT_DATE())) AS avg_days_inactive,
    MIN(esp_patch_version) AS min_patch_version,
    MAX(last_communication) AS last_communication
FROM dim_mcafee_endpoints
GROUP BY 1;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_OBJECTS_SUMMARY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OBJECTS_SUMMARY AS
SELECT 
    table_catalog     AS environment,
    table_schema      AS schema_name,
    table_name,
    table_type,
    created,
    last_altered
FROM 
    information_schema.tables
WHERE 
    table_schema = 'SECURITY_ANALYTICS';

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_SCAN_COMPLIANCE
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_scan_compliance AS
SELECT
    bu,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.asset_id) AS total_assets,           -- Specify table alias
    COUNT_IF(scan_date > DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_DATE())) AS recently_scanned,
    AVG(scan_duration_seconds) AS avg_scan_duration
FROM dim_host_assets a
JOIN fact_scan_events s ON a.asset_id = s.asset_id
GROUP BY bu;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_FIXEDVULN_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_fixedvuln_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    COUNT_IF(last_fixed IS NULL) AS null_fix_dates,
    COUNT_IF(remediation_days < 0) AS negative_fix_times
FROM fact_remediation_events;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_SNOW_SECURITY_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_snow_security_alerts AS
SELECT 
    'INACTIVE_DEVICE' AS alert_type,
    computer_name,
    last_scanned,
    'Last scanned over 30 days ago' AS description
FROM dim_snow_devices
WHERE DATEDIFF(day, last_scanned, CURRENT_DATE()) > 30
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'OUTDATED_CLIENT',
    computer_name,
    last_scanned,
    'Client version older than 6.0: ' || client_version
FROM dim_snow_devices
WHERE TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(client_version, '.', 1) AS NUMBER) < 6
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'OUT_OF_SCOPE',
    computer_name,
    last_scanned,
    'Device not in security scope'
FROM dim_snow_devices
WHERE NOT in_scope;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_STOCK_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_stock_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    COUNT_IF(bios_serial_number IS NULL) AS missing_serials,
    COUNT_IF(last_scanned < DATEADD('year', -1, CURRENT_DATE())) AS stale_records,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'Inactive') AS inactive_devices
FROM dim_hardware_inventory;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_HOST_INVENTORY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_host_inventory AS
SELECT 
    asset_id,
    ip,
    os,
    bu,
    DATE(first_found_date) AS first_discovered,
    DATEDIFF(day, last_activity, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_inactive
FROM dim_host_assets;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_QUALYS_REPORT
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_qualys_report AS
SELECT 
    'HOST' AS record_type,
    host_key,
    host_tracking_method,
    host_os,
    inscope,
    last_vm_auth_scan_date
FROM qualys_host_data
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'VULNERABILITY' AS record_type,
    vuln_key,
    NULL AS host_tracking_method,
    NULL AS host_os,
    NULL AS inscope,
    NULL AS last_vm_auth_scan_date
FROM qualys_vuln_kb_data;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_THREAT_INTEL_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_threat_intel_alerts AS
SELECT 
    'HIGH_FAILURE_RATE' AS alert_type,
    source,
    asset_type,
    COUNT_IF(NOT takedown_successful) AS failed_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_events
FROM fact_threat_intel_events
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
HAVING failed_count / total_events > 0.8
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'DATA_RECENCY_ISSUE',
    'SUMMARY',
    'N/A',
    MAX(DATEDIFF(day, month_year, CURRENT_DATE())),
    NULL
FROM fact_threat_intel_summary
WHERE DATEDIFF(month, month_year, CURRENT_DATE()) > 3;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_ACCOUNT_SECURITY_STATUS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_account_security_status AS
SELECT 
    username,
    email_address,
    opco,
    account_is_locked_out,
    disabled,
    password_age_days,
    last_logon_date
FROM dim_leviat_users;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_BITSIGHT_SECURITY_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_bitsight_security_alerts AS
SELECT
    domain_name,
    tags,
    'CRITICAL_FINDING' AS alert_type,
    risk_vector_label || ': ' || finding AS description,
    last_seen
FROM fact_bitsight_findings
WHERE severity = 'CRITICAL' AND last_seen >= DATEADD(month, -1, CURRENT_DATE());

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_CISCO_AMP_REPORT
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_CISCO_AMP_report AS
SELECT 
    Connector_GUID,
    Hostname,
    Last_Seen,
    Connector_Version,
    Operating_System,
    Is_Active
FROM CISCO_AMP_data;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_CYBELANGEL_ACTIVE_THREATS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_cybelangel_active_threats AS
SELECT 
    a.incident_id,
    a.detection_date,
    a.severity,
    a.source,
    t.threat_type,
    t.volume_documents
FROM dim_cybelangel_alerts a
JOIN fact_cybelangel_threats t 
    ON a.alert_key = t.alert_key
WHERE a.status NOT IN ('resolved', 'discarded');

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_CYBELANGEL_CRITICAL_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_cybelangel_critical_alerts AS
SELECT 
    'HIGH_SEVERITY' AS alert_type,
    incident_id,
    'Unresolved high severity alert' AS description,
    detection_date
FROM dim_cybelangel_alerts
WHERE severity IN ('ReportSeverity.MAJOR', 'ReportSeverity.CRITICAL')
    AND status NOT IN ('resolved', 'discarded')
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'STALE_ALERT',
    incident_id,
    'No status update in last 30 days',
    detection_date
FROM dim_cybelangel_alerts
WHERE DATEDIFF(day, status_checking_date, CURRENT_DATE()) > 30
    AND status NOT IN ('resolved', 'discarded');

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_SOPHOS_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_sophos_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(last_active IS NULL) AS null_last_active,
    COUNT_IF(health_status IS NULL) AS null_health_status,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF(day, last_active, CURRENT_DATE()) > 30) AS inactive_30_days
FROM dim_sophos_endpoints;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_SOPHOS_SECURITY_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_sophos_security_alerts AS
SELECT 
    'UNHEALTHY_ENDPOINT' AS alert_type,
    name,
    health_status,
    last_active
FROM dim_sophos_endpoints
WHERE health_status != 'Healthy'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'INACTIVE_ENDPOINT',
    name,
    health_status,
    last_active
FROM dim_sophos_endpoints
WHERE DATEDIFF(day, last_active, CURRENT_DATE()) > 14;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_ZEROFOX_ALERT_SUMMARY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_zerofox_alert_summary AS
SELECT 
    a.alert_type,
    a.severity,
    z.type AS asset_type,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count,
    MIN(a.created_at) AS first_occurrence,
    MAX(a.created_at) AS last_occurrence
FROM fact_zerofox_alerts a
JOIN dim_zerofox_assets z ON a.asset_id = z.asset_id
GROUP BY 1,2,3;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_FIXEDVULN_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_fixedvuln_alerts AS
SELECT 
    event_id,
    'LONG_REMEDIATION' AS alert_type,
    remediation_days || ' days to fix' AS description
FROM fact_remediation_events
WHERE remediation_days > 30
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    event_id,
    'FREQUENT_REOPEN',
    times_reopened || ' reopenings'
FROM fact_remediation_events
WHERE times_reopened > 3;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_LEVIAT_SECURITY_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_leviat_security_alerts AS
SELECT
    'LOCKED_ACCOUNT' AS alert_type,
    username,
    'Account is locked out' AS description
FROM dim_leviat_users
WHERE account_is_locked_out = TRUE

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'PASSWORD_EXPIRED',
    username,
    'Password expired >90 days'
FROM dim_leviat_users
WHERE password_age_days > 90

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'INACTIVE_ACCOUNT',
    username,
    'No logon in 90 days'
FROM dim_leviat_users
WHERE last_logon_date < DATEADD(day, -90, CURRENT_DATE())

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'FREQUENT_FAILED_LOGONS',
    username,
    '>5 failed logon attempts'
FROM fact_leviat_security_events
WHERE event_type = 'Failed Logon'
GROUP BY username
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_SECURITY_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_security_alerts AS
SELECT 
    'HIGH_RISK_ENDPOINT' AS alert_type,
    device_hostname,
    'No connection in 7 days' AS description
FROM dim_zscaler_endpoints
WHERE DATEDIFF(day, last_connected, CURRENT_DATE()) > 7
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'FREQUENT_THREATS',
    device_hostname,
    'More than 5 threats in 24 hours'
FROM fact_zscaler_threats
WHERE threat_date > DATEADD(hour, -24, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
GROUP BY device_hostname
HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.V_.name: V_DEVICES_WITH_THREATS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.V_.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.V_DEVICES_WITH_THREATS AS
SELECT 
    DEVICE_NAME,
    DEVICE_GROUP,
    OPERATING_SYSTEM,
    TOTAL_THREATS,
    UNIQUE_THREATS,
    THREATS_PREVENTED,
    THREATS_DETECTED,
    FIRST_THREAT_DATE,
    LAST_THREAT_DATE,
    ALL_THREAT_NAMES,
    DEVICE_SECURITY_STATUS,
    HAS_UNRESOLVED_THREATS
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SYMANTEC_CONSOLIDATED
WHERE HAS_THREATS = 'Y'
ORDER BY TOTAL_THREATS DESC;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.V_.name: V_GROUP_SUMMARY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.V_.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.V_GROUP_SUMMARY AS
SELECT 
    DEVICE_GROUP,
    COUNT(*) as TOTAL_DEVICES,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN HAS_THREATS = 'Y' THEN 1 END) as DEVICES_WITH_THREATS,
    SUM(TOTAL_THREATS) as TOTAL_THREATS_GROUP,
    AVG(TOTAL_THREATS) as AVG_THREATS_PER_DEVICE,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN DEVICE_SECURITY_STATUS = 'Protected' THEN 1 END) as PROTECTED_DEVICES,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN HAS_UNRESOLVED_THREATS = TRUE THEN 1 END) as DEVICES_WITH_UNRESOLVED_THREATS
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SYMANTEC_CONSOLIDATED
WHERE DEVICE_GROUP IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DEVICE_GROUP
ORDER BY TOTAL_THREATS_GROUP DESC;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_ANCON_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_ancon_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    CURRENT_DATE() AS monitor_date,
    COUNT(*) AS total_users,
    COUNT_IF(email_address IS NULL) AS missing_emails,
    COUNT_IF(password_last_changed IS NULL) AS never_changed_password,
    COUNT_IF(last_logon_date < DATEADD('year', -1, CURRENT_DATE())) AS inactive_1_year
FROM dim_ancon_users;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_BITSIGHT_CURRENT_FINDINGS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_bitsight_current_findings AS
SELECT
    f.domain_name,
    f.tags,
    f.details_grade,
    f.last_seen,
    f.risk_vector_label,
    v.category,
    f.finding,
    f.severity,
    f.affects_rating,
    v.recommended_action
FROM fact_bitsight_findings f
JOIN dim_bitsight_risk_vectors v
    ON f.risk_vector_label = v.risk_vector_label
WHERE f.last_seen >= DATEADD(month, -3, CURRENT_DATE());

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_CROWDSTRIKE_REPORT
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_crowdstrike_report AS
SELECT 
    e.hostname,
    e.platform,
    e.os_product_name,
    e.sensor_version,
    v.support_date AS version_eol,
    e.last_seen,
    e.status,
    e.is_active,
    CASE 
        WHEN v.days_until_eol < 0 THEN 'EOL'
        WHEN v.days_until_eol < 30 THEN 'NEAR_EOL'
        ELSE 'SUPPORTED'
    END AS version_status
FROM crowdstrike_endpoints e
LEFT JOIN crowdstrike_versions v
    ON e.sensor_version = v.version;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_DEFENDER_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_defender_alerts AS
SELECT 
    device_id,
    'Non-compliant device' AS alert_description
FROM dim_defender_endpoints
WHERE compliance != 'Compliant'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    device_id,
    'Inactive >7 days' 
FROM dim_defender_endpoints
WHERE DATEDIFF('day', last_status_update, CURRENT_DATE()) > 7;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_FARRANS_ALERT_SUMMARY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_farrans_alert_summary AS
SELECT 
    health_status,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    MAX(last_active) AS latest_activity
FROM fact_farrans_health
GROUP BY health_status;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_TRELLIX_SECURITY_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_trellix_security_alerts AS
SELECT 
    'STALE_ENDPOINT' AS alert_type,
    system_name,
    last_communication,
    DATEDIFF(day, last_communication, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_inactive
FROM dim_trellix_endpoints
WHERE DATEDIFF(day, last_communication, CURRENT_DATE()) > 7
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'OUTDATED_AMCORE',
    system_name,
    amcore_date,
    DATEDIFF(day, amcore_date, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_outdated
FROM dim_trellix_endpoints
WHERE DATEDIFF(day, amcore_date, CURRENT_DATE()) > 30;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_ANCON_SECURITY_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_ancon_security_alerts AS
SELECT 
    alert_type,
    username,
    description,
    email_address AS contact
FROM (
    SELECT 
        'DISABLED_ACCOUNT' AS alert_type,
        username,
        'Account marked as disabled' AS description,
        email_address
    FROM dim_ancon_users
    WHERE disabled
    
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'PASSWORD_EXPIRED',
        username,
        'Password not changed in ' || password_age_days || ' days',
        email_address
    FROM dim_ancon_users
    WHERE password_age_days > 90 
      AND NOT password_never_expires
      AND password_last_changed IS NOT NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'PASSWORD_NEVER_CHANGED',
        username,
        'Password has never been changed',
        email_address
    FROM dim_ancon_users
    WHERE password_last_changed IS NULL
    
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        'NO_RECENT_LOGON',
        username,
        'No login in last ' || DATEDIFF('day', last_logon_date, CURRENT_DATE()) || ' days',
        email_address
    FROM dim_ancon_users
    WHERE DATEDIFF('day', last_logon_date, CURRENT_DATE()) > 60
);

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_DEVICE_OS_COMPLIANCE
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_device_os_compliance AS
SELECT
    operating_system,
    client_version,
    COUNT(*) AS device_count,
    AVG(DATEDIFF(day, last_scanned, CURRENT_DATE())) AS avg_days_since_scan
FROM dim_snow_devices
GROUP BY 1, 2;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_HOST_ACTIVITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_host_activity AS
SELECT 
    opco,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', last_seen) AS activity_month,
    COUNT(*) AS active_hosts
FROM dim_splunk_hosts
GROUP BY 1,2;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_ZEROFOX_SECURITY_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_zerofox_security_alerts AS
SELECT 
    'HIGH_SEVERITY_DOMAIN' AS alert_type,
    a.alert_id,
    a.asset_id,
    'Unresolved high-severity domain alert' AS description,
    a.created_at
FROM fact_zerofox_alerts a
JOIN dim_zerofox_assets z ON a.asset_id = z.asset_id
WHERE a.severity = 'high'
    AND a.status = 'open'
    AND a.network_name = 'domains'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'UNRESOLVED_OLD_ALERT',
    alert_id,
    asset_id,
    'Alert older than 7 days still open',
    created_at
FROM fact_zerofox_alerts
WHERE status = 'open'
    AND DATEDIFF(day, created_at, CURRENT_DATE()) > 7
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'PROTECTED_DOMAIN_EXPOSURE',
    alert_id,
    z.asset_id,
    'Protected domain found in alert: ' || z.domains,
    a.created_at
FROM fact_zerofox_alerts a
JOIN dim_zerofox_assets z ON a.asset_id = z.asset_id
WHERE a.offending_content_text LIKE '%' || z.domains || '%'
    AND z.status = 'protected';

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_QUALYS_COMPLIANCE
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_qualys_compliance AS
SELECT 
    'HOST' AS record_type,
    COUNT_IF(last_vm_auth_scan_date < DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE())) AS stale_hosts,
    COUNT_IF(NOT inscope) AS out_of_scope_hosts
FROM qualys_host_data
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'VULNERABILITY' AS record_type,
    COUNT_IF(severity_level >= 4 AND NOT patchable) AS critical_unpatched,
    COUNT_IF(exploitable) AS exploitable_vulns
FROM qualys_vuln_kb_data;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_AV_REGIONAL_HEALTH
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_av_regional_health AS
SELECT
    o.region,
    f.report_month,
    ROUND(AVG(f.av_installed_pct), 4) AS avg_av_installed,
    COUNT_IF(f.av_installed_pct < 0.85) AS non_compliant_opcos
FROM fact_av_health f
JOIN dim_av_opco o ON f.opco_name = o.opco_name
GROUP BY o.region, f.report_month;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_CYBELANGEL_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_cybelangel_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    'ALERTS' AS table_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_records,
    COUNT_IF(detection_date IS NULL) AS null_detection_date,
    COUNT_IF(incident_type IS NULL) AS null_incident_type
FROM dim_cybelangel_alerts
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'THREATS',
    COUNT(*),
    COUNT_IF(threat_date IS NULL),
    COUNT_IF(threat_type IS NULL)
FROM fact_cybelangel_threats;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_DOMAIN_PROTECTION_STATUS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_domain_protection_status AS
SELECT
    z.domains AS protected_domain,
    COUNT(a.alert_id) AS alert_count,
    BOOLAND_AGG(a.content_removed) AS all_removed,
    MIN(a.created_at) AS first_alert,
    MAX(a.created_at) AS last_alert
FROM dim_zerofox_assets z
LEFT JOIN fact_zerofox_alerts a 
    ON z.asset_id = a.asset_id
    AND a.network_name = 'domains'
GROUP BY 1;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_FARRANS_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_farrans_alerts AS
SELECT 
    endpoint_name,
    'UNPROTECTED_ENDPOINT' AS alert_type
FROM dim_farrans_endpoints
WHERE protection NOT ILIKE '%Intercept X%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    endpoint_name,
    'INACTIVE_30_DAYS'
FROM fact_farrans_health
WHERE DATEDIFF('day', last_active, CURRENT_DATE()) > 30;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_SPLUNK_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_splunk_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    'HOSTS' AS table_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_records,
    COUNT_IF(last_seen IS NULL) AS null_last_seen,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF('DAY', last_seen, CURRENT_DATE()) > 90) AS stale_hosts
FROM dim_splunk_hosts
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'ALERTS',
    COUNT(*),
    COUNT_IF(created_time IS NULL),
    COUNT_IF(resolved_time IS NULL)
FROM fact_splunk_alerts;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_CYBELANGEL_ALERT_SUMMARY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_cybelangel_alert_summary AS
SELECT 
    status,
    severity,
    incident_type,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count,
    MIN(detection_date) AS earliest_detection,
    MAX(detection_date) AS latest_detection
FROM dim_cybelangel_alerts
GROUP BY 1,2,3;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    'ENDPOINTS' AS table_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_records,
    COUNT_IF(last_connected IS NULL) AS null_last_connected,
    COUNT_IF(registration_date IS NULL) AS null_registration_date
FROM dim_zscaler_endpoints
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'THREATS',
    COUNT(*),
    COUNT_IF(threat_date IS NULL),
    COUNT_IF(device_hostname IS NULL)
FROM fact_zscaler_threats;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_DEFENDER_COMPLIANCE_SUMMARY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_defender_compliance_summary AS
SELECT compliance, COUNT(*) AS device_count
FROM dim_defender_endpoints
GROUP BY compliance;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_HOSTS_SECURITY_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_hosts_security_alerts AS
SELECT 
    'INACTIVE_ASSET' AS alert_type,
    asset_id,
    'No activity in 90 days' AS description
FROM dim_host_assets
WHERE last_activity < DATEADD(day, -90, CURRENT_DATE())
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'UNSCANNED_ASSET',
    asset_id,
    'No scan in last 30 days'
FROM dim_host_assets
WHERE asset_id NOT IN (
    SELECT asset_id 
    FROM fact_scan_events 
    WHERE scan_date > DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE())
)
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'MISSING_OS',
    asset_id,
    'Operating system not identified'
FROM dim_host_assets
WHERE os IS NULL OR os = '';

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_LEVIAT_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_leviat_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    'USER_ACCOUNTS' AS table_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_records,
    COUNT_IF(expiration_date IS NULL) AS null_expiration_date,
    COUNT_IF(last_logon_date IS NULL) AS null_last_logon
FROM dim_leviat_users
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'SECURITY_EVENTS',
    COUNT(*),
    COUNT_IF(event_timestamp IS NULL),
    COUNT_IF(username IS NULL)
FROM fact_leviat_security_events;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_MONTHLY_THREAT_TRENDS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_monthly_threat_trends AS
SELECT
    d.month_name,
    s.opco,
    s.source,
    s.total_events,
    COUNT(e.event_key) AS event_count
FROM fact_threat_intel_summary s
JOIN dim_dates d ON s.month_year = DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', d.date)
LEFT JOIN fact_threat_intel_events e 
    ON DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', e.event_date) = s.month_year
    AND e.source = s.source
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_SNOW_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_snow_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_devices,
    COUNT_IF(last_scanned IS NULL) AS null_last_scanned,
    COUNT_IF(physical_processors IS NULL) AS null_processor_count,
    COUNT_IF(status IS NULL) AS null_status
FROM dim_snow_devices;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_STOCK_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_stock_alerts AS
SELECT 
    computer_name,
    'INACTIVE_DEVICE' AS alert_type,
    'Device inactive for >90 days' AS description
FROM dim_hardware_inventory
WHERE status = 'Inactive'
  AND DATEDIFF('day', last_scanned, CURRENT_DATE()) > 90;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_TRENDMICRO_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_trendmicro_alerts AS
SELECT 
    'CRITICAL' AS severity,
    'Outdated security > 15%' AS alert_description
FROM vw_trendmicro_data_quality
WHERE outdated_security > total_endpoints * 0.15
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'WARNING', 
    'Offline devices > 10%'
FROM vw_trendmicro_data_quality
WHERE offline_devices > total_endpoints * 0.1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'MEDIUM', 
    'Stale devices > 5%'
FROM vw_trendmicro_data_quality
WHERE stale_devices > total_endpoints * 0.05;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_ZEROFOX_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_zerofox_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    'ASSETS' AS table_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_records,
    COUNT_IF(asset_id IS NULL) AS null_asset_id,
    COUNT_IF(domains IS NULL) AS null_domains
FROM dim_zerofox_assets
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'ALERTS',
    COUNT(*),
    COUNT_IF(asset_id IS NULL),
    COUNT_IF(created_at IS NULL)
FROM fact_zerofox_alerts;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_ANCON_KEY_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_ancon_key_quality AS
SELECT 
    key_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT value) AS distinct_count,
    COUNT(*) - distinct_count AS duplicate_count,
    COUNT_IF(value IS NULL) AS null_count
FROM (
    SELECT 'PK' AS key_type, username AS value FROM dim_ancon_users
    UNION ALL SELECT 'NK', distinguished_name FROM dim_ancon_users
    UNION ALL SELECT 'AK', email_address FROM dim_ancon_users
)
GROUP BY key_type
--COMMENT = 'Data quality for primary/natural/alternate keys';
;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_AV_HEALTH_TREND
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_av_health_trend AS
SELECT
    o.opco_name,
    o.region,
    o.category,
    f.report_month,
    f.av_health_score,
    f.av_installed_pct,
    f.old_signatures_pct,
    f.old_client_version_pct,
    f.host_firewall_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(f.av_health_score) OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.region 
        ORDER BY f.report_month 
        ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ), 4) AS region_3mo_avg
FROM fact_av_health f
JOIN dim_av_opco o ON f.opco_name = o.opco_name;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_ENDPOINT_SECURITY_STATUS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_endpoint_security_status AS
SELECT 
    e.device_hostname,
    e.device_type,
    e.os_version,
    e.policy_name,
    e.last_connected,
    COUNT(t.threat_id) AS threat_count,
    MAX(t.threat_date) AS latest_threat
FROM dim_zscaler_endpoints e
LEFT JOIN fact_zscaler_threats t 
    ON e.device_hostname = t.device_hostname
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_SYMANTEC_CONSOLIDATED
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SYMANTEC_CONSOLIDATED AS
WITH computers_base AS (
    SELECT 
        -- Key identification fields
        COMPUTER_NAME,
        DEVICE_DOMAIN,
        GROUP_NAME,
        LOGIN_USER,
        
        -- Device information
        DEVICE_DESCRIPTION,
        DEVICE_CREATION_TIME,
        CLIENT_TYPE,
        CLIENT_VERSION,
        MANAGED_BY,
        DEVICE_SECURITY_STATUS,
        DEVICE_STATUS_REASON,
        DEVICE_LAST_UPDATE_TIME,
        DEVICE_RESTART_REQUIRED,
        
        -- Operating system
        OPERATING_SYSTEM,
        OPERATING_SYSTEM_LANGUAGE,
        OPERATING_SYSTEM_VERSION,
        TIME_ZONE_OFFSET,
        VIRTUAL_MACHINE,
        
        -- Hardware
        DEVICE_MODEL_VENDOR,
        BIOS_INFORMATION,
        CPU_TYPE,
        CPU_CLOCK,
        TOTAL_MEMORY_MB,
        FREE_DISK_MB,
        TOTAL_DISK_MB,
        
        -- Network
        DNS_ADDRESSES,
        MAC_ADDRESSES,
        IPV4_ADDRESSES,
        SUBNET_MASK,
        IPV6_ADDRESSES,
        
        -- Malware protection
        MALWARE_PROTECTION,
        MALWARE_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION,
        MALWARE_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION,
        MALWARE_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
        HAS_UNRESOLVED_THREATS,
        LAST_VIRUS_DETECTION_TIME,
        LAST_SCAN_TIME,
        
        -- Behavioral analysis
        BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS,
        BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_ENGINE_VERSION,
        BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_CONTENT_VERSION,
        BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
        
        -- Exploit protection
        EXPLOIT_PROTECTION,
        EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION,
        EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION,
        EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
        
        -- Intrusion prevention
        INTRUSION_PREVENTION,
        INTRUSION_PREVENTION_ENGINE_VERSION,
        INTRUSION_PREVENTION_CONTENT_VERSION,
        INTRUSION_PREVENTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
        
        -- Browser protection
        BROWSER_PROTECTION,
        BROWSER_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION,
        BROWSER_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION,
        BROWSER_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
        
        -- Web security
        WEB_SECURITY,
        WEB_SECURITY_ENGINE_VERSION,
        WEB_SECURITY_CONTENT_VERSION,
        WEB_SECURITY_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
        
        -- Additional controls
        DEVICE_CONTROL,
        FIREWALL,
        TDAD,
        
        -- Application control
        APP_CONTROL,
        APP_CONTROL_ENGINE_VERSION,
        APP_CONTROL_CONTENT_VERSION,
        APP_CONTROL_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
        
        -- EDR
        EDR,
        EDR_ENGINE_VERSION,
        EDR_CONTENT_VERSION,
        
        -- Host integrity
        HOST_INTEGRITY,
        HOST_INTEGRITY_ENGINE_VERSION,
        HOST_INTEGRITY_CONTENT_VERSION,
        HOST_INTEGRITY_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
        
        -- Metadata
        GROUP_UPPER,
        SYMANTEC_OPCO,
        SYMANTEC_VERSIONS_INDEX,
        SYMANTECCLIENTRELEASEDATE,
        SYMANTECLASTCLIENTUPDATE,
        UNITY
        
    FROM DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.SYMANTEC_COMPUTERS
),

threats_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        DEVICE_NAME,
        DEVICE_GROUP,
        
        -- Threat counters
        COUNT(*) as TOTAL_THREATS,
        COUNT(DISTINCT THREAT_NAME) as UNIQUE_THREATS,
        COUNT(DISTINCT TYPE) as THREAT_TYPES_COUNT,
        
        -- Threats by type
        SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'Threats Prevented' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as THREATS_PREVENTED,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TYPE = 'Threats Detected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as THREATS_DETECTED,
        
        -- Most used features
        COUNT(DISTINCT FEATURE_NAME) as PROTECTION_FEATURES_USED,
        
        -- Temporal information
        MIN(TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(DATESEEN, 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI')) as FIRST_THREAT_DATE,
        MAX(TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(DATESEEN, 'DD-MM-YYYY HH24:MI')) as LAST_THREAT_DATE,
        
        -- Top threats (concatenated)
        LISTAGG(DISTINCT THREAT_NAME, '; ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY THREAT_NAME) as ALL_THREAT_NAMES,
        
        -- Affected users
        COUNT(DISTINCT USER_NAME) as AFFECTED_USERS,
        LISTAGG(DISTINCT USER_NAME, '; ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY USER_NAME) as USER_LIST,
        
        -- Most common files
        COUNT(DISTINCT FILE_NAME) as UNIQUE_FILES_AFFECTED,
        
        -- Activated protection features
        LISTAGG(DISTINCT FEATURE_NAME, '; ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY FEATURE_NAME) as PROTECTION_FEATURES
        
    FROM DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.SYMANTEC_THREATS
    GROUP BY DEVICE_NAME, DEVICE_GROUP
)

-- Final consolidation
SELECT 
    -- Computer information
    COALESCE(c.COMPUTER_NAME, t.DEVICE_NAME) as DEVICE_NAME,
    c.DEVICE_DOMAIN,
    COALESCE(c.GROUP_NAME, t.DEVICE_GROUP) as DEVICE_GROUP,
    c.LOGIN_USER,
    
    -- Device information
    c.DEVICE_DESCRIPTION,
    c.DEVICE_CREATION_TIME,
    c.CLIENT_TYPE,
    c.CLIENT_VERSION,
    c.MANAGED_BY,
    c.DEVICE_SECURITY_STATUS,
    c.DEVICE_STATUS_REASON,
    c.DEVICE_LAST_UPDATE_TIME,
    c.DEVICE_RESTART_REQUIRED,
    
    -- Operating system
    c.OPERATING_SYSTEM,
    c.OPERATING_SYSTEM_LANGUAGE,
    c.OPERATING_SYSTEM_VERSION,
    c.TIME_ZONE_OFFSET,
    c.VIRTUAL_MACHINE,
    
    -- Hardware
    c.DEVICE_MODEL_VENDOR,
    c.BIOS_INFORMATION,
    c.CPU_TYPE,
    c.CPU_CLOCK,
    c.TOTAL_MEMORY_MB,
    c.FREE_DISK_MB,
    c.TOTAL_DISK_MB,
    
    -- Network
    c.DNS_ADDRESSES,
    c.MAC_ADDRESSES,
    c.IPV4_ADDRESSES,
    c.SUBNET_MASK,
    c.IPV6_ADDRESSES,
    
    -- Malware protection
    c.MALWARE_PROTECTION,
    c.MALWARE_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION,
    c.MALWARE_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION,
    c.MALWARE_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
    c.HAS_UNRESOLVED_THREATS,
    c.LAST_VIRUS_DETECTION_TIME,
    c.LAST_SCAN_TIME,
    
    -- Behavioral analysis
    c.BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS,
    c.BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_ENGINE_VERSION,
    c.BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_CONTENT_VERSION,
    c.BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
    
    -- Exploit protection
    c.EXPLOIT_PROTECTION,
    c.EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION,
    c.EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION,
    c.EXPLOIT_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
    
    -- Intrusion prevention
    c.INTRUSION_PREVENTION,
    c.INTRUSION_PREVENTION_ENGINE_VERSION,
    c.INTRUSION_PREVENTION_CONTENT_VERSION,
    c.INTRUSION_PREVENTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
    
    -- Browser protection
    c.BROWSER_PROTECTION,
    c.BROWSER_PROTECTION_ENGINE_VERSION,
    c.BROWSER_PROTECTION_CONTENT_VERSION,
    c.BROWSER_PROTECTION_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
    
    -- Web security
    c.WEB_SECURITY,
    c.WEB_SECURITY_ENGINE_VERSION,
    c.WEB_SECURITY_CONTENT_VERSION,
    c.WEB_SECURITY_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
    
    -- Additional controls
    c.DEVICE_CONTROL,
    c.FIREWALL,
    c.TDAD,
    
    -- Application control
    c.APP_CONTROL,
    c.APP_CONTROL_ENGINE_VERSION,
    c.APP_CONTROL_CONTENT_VERSION,
    c.APP_CONTROL_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
    
    -- EDR
    c.EDR,
    c.EDR_ENGINE_VERSION,
    c.EDR_CONTENT_VERSION,
    
    -- Host integrity
    c.HOST_INTEGRITY,
    c.HOST_INTEGRITY_ENGINE_VERSION,
    c.HOST_INTEGRITY_CONTENT_VERSION,
    c.HOST_INTEGRITY_LAST_DOWNLOAD_TIME,
    
    -- Metadata
    c.GROUP_UPPER,
    c.SYMANTEC_OPCO,
    c.SYMANTEC_VERSIONS_INDEX,
    c.SYMANTECCLIENTRELEASEDATE,
    c.SYMANTECLASTCLIENTUPDATE,
    c.UNITY,
    
    -- Aggregated threat information
    COALESCE(t.TOTAL_THREATS, 0) as TOTAL_THREATS,
    COALESCE(t.UNIQUE_THREATS, 0) as UNIQUE_THREATS,
    COALESCE(t.THREAT_TYPES_COUNT, 0) as THREAT_TYPES_COUNT,
    COALESCE(t.THREATS_PREVENTED, 0) as THREATS_PREVENTED,
    COALESCE(t.THREATS_DETECTED, 0) as THREATS_DETECTED,
    COALESCE(t.PROTECTION_FEATURES_USED, 0) as PROTECTION_FEATURES_USED,
    t.FIRST_THREAT_DATE,
    t.LAST_THREAT_DATE,
    t.ALL_THREAT_NAMES,
    COALESCE(t.AFFECTED_USERS, 0) as AFFECTED_USERS,
    t.USER_LIST,
    COALESCE(t.UNIQUE_FILES_AFFECTED, 0) as UNIQUE_FILES_AFFECTED,
    t.PROTECTION_FEATURES,
    
    -- Calculated indicators
    CASE 
        WHEN t.TOTAL_THREATS > 0 THEN 'Y' 
        ELSE 'N' 
    END as HAS_THREATS,
    
    CASE 
        WHEN c.COMPUTER_NAME IS NOT NULL AND t.DEVICE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'BOTH'
        WHEN c.COMPUTER_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMPUTER_ONLY'
        WHEN t.DEVICE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN 'THREATS_ONLY'
        ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END as DATA_SOURCE,
    
    -- Consolidation timestamp
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() as CONSOLIDATION_TIMESTAMP

FROM computers_base c
FULL OUTER JOIN threats_agg t ON c.COMPUTER_NAME = t.DEVICE_NAME;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_TRELLIX_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_trellix_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(last_communication IS NULL) AS null_last_comm,
    COUNT_IF(amcore_version IS NULL) AS null_amcore_version,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF(day, last_communication, CURRENT_DATE()) > 30) AS stale_30_days,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF(day, amcore_date, CURRENT_DATE()) > 30) AS outdated_amcore
FROM dim_trellix_endpoints;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_FARRANS_ENDPOINT_HEALTH
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_farrans_endpoint_health AS
SELECT 
    e.endpoint_name,
    e.os,
    e.protection,
    h.health_status,
    h.last_active
FROM dim_farrans_endpoints e
JOIN fact_farrans_health h 
    ON e.endpoint_name = h.endpoint_name;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_MCAFEE_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_mcafee_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    'ENDPOINTS' AS table_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_records,
    COUNT_IF(last_communication IS NULL) AS null_last_comm,
    COUNT_IF(esp_patch_version IS NULL) AS null_patch_version,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF(day, last_communication, CURRENT_DATE()) > 7) AS stale_7_days
FROM dim_mcafee_endpoints;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_TRELLIX_ENDPOINT_STATUS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_trellix_endpoint_status AS
SELECT
    domain_name,
    os_type,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    MIN(last_communication) AS oldest_communication,
    MAX(last_communication) AS newest_communication,
    AVG(DATEDIFF(day, last_communication, CURRENT_DATE())) AS avg_days_since_comm
FROM dim_trellix_endpoints
GROUP BY 1, 2;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_TRENDMICRO_REPORTING
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_trendmicro_reporting AS
SELECT * FROM fact_trendmicro_endpoints;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_SOPHOS_ENDPOINT_HEALTH
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_sophos_endpoint_health AS
SELECT
    health_status,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    AVG(DATEDIFF(day, last_active, CURRENT_DATE())) AS avg_days_inactive
FROM dim_sophos_endpoints
GROUP BY 1;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_CROWDSTRIKE_COMPLIANCE
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_crowdstrike_compliance AS
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('day', last_seen) AS report_date,
    COUNT_IF(NOT is_active) AS inactive_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(sensor_version NOT IN (
        SELECT version FROM crowdstrike_versions WHERE days_until_eol >= 0
    )) AS unsupported_versions,
    COUNT_IF(os_product_name ILIKE '%server 2012%') AS unsupported_os
FROM crowdstrike_endpoints
GROUP BY report_date;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_HOSTS_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_hosts_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    'ASSETS' AS table_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_records,
    COUNT_IF(ip IS NULL) AS null_ip,
    COUNT_IF(bu IS NULL) AS null_bu
FROM dim_host_assets
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'SCAN_EVENTS',
    COUNT(*),
    COUNT_IF(scan_date IS NULL),
    COUNT_IF(asset_id IS NULL)
FROM fact_scan_events;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_TRENDMICRO_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_trendmicro_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(status != 'Managed (Online)') AS offline_devices,
    COUNT_IF(security_update_status = 'Out-of-Date') AS outdated_security,
    COUNT_IF(software_update_status = 'Out-of-Date') AS outdated_software,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF('day', last_seen_date, CURRENT_DATE()) > 7) AS stale_devices,
    COUNT(DISTINCT platform) AS platform_count,
    MAX(load_timestamp) AS last_refreshed
FROM fact_trendmicro_endpoints;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_FIXED_VULNERABILITY_SUMMARY
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_fixed_vulnerability_summary AS
SELECT
    v.severity,
    COUNT(*) AS total_fixes,
    AVG(f.remediation_days) AS avg_fix_days
FROM fact_remediation_events f
JOIN dim_fixed_vulnerabilities v ON f.qid = v.qid
WHERE f.remediation_days IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY v.severity;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_PASSWORD_HEALTH
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_password_health AS
SELECT 
    opco,
    COUNT_IF(password_age_days > 90) AS expired_passwords,
    COUNT_IF(password_never_expires) AS never_expire_count
FROM dim_leviat_users
GROUP BY opco;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_SENTINEL_ALERTS
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_sentinel_alerts AS
SELECT 
    'CRITICAL' AS severity,
    'Outdated agents > 10%' AS alert_description
FROM vw_sentinel_data_quality
WHERE outdated_agents > total_endpoints * 0.1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'WARNING', 
    'Inactive devices > 20%'
FROM vw_sentinel_data_quality
WHERE inactive_devices > total_endpoints * 0.2;

DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.name: VW_THREAT_EVENTS_BY_SOURCE
DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW vw_threat_events_by_source AS
SELECT
    source,
    asset_type,
    COUNT_IF(takedown_successful) AS successful_takedowns,
    COUNT(*) AS total_events,
    successful_takedowns / total_events AS success_rate
FROM fact_threat_intel_events
GROUP BY 1, 2;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ANCO.name: VW_ANCON_COMPLIANCE_SETTINGS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ANCO.definition:

AS
SELECT
    'PASSWORD_AGE_THRESHOLD' AS parameter_name,
    90 AS parameter_value,
    'Maximum allowed password age (days)' AS description

UNION ALL

SELECT

    'Days without login to consider account inactive'

;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_AV_R.name: VW_AV_REGIONAL_TREND
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_AV_R.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_av_regional_trend

AS
SELECT
    region,
    report_month,
    ROUND(AVG(av_installed_pct) * 100, 2) AS avg_edr_coverage_pct,
    ROUND(AVG(av_health_score) * 100, 2) AS avg_health_score,
    COUNT_IF(av_installed_pct < 0.98) AS non_compliant_opcos
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_av_health f
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_av_opco o 
  ON f.opco_name = o.opco_name
GROUP BY region, report_month;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_BITS.name: VW_BITSIGHT_CRITICAL_FINDINGS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_BITS.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_bitsight_critical_findings

AS
SELECT
    f.domain_name,
    f.tags AS vendor_tags,
    f.risk_vector_label,
    v.category,
    f.finding,
    f.evidence,
    f.last_seen,
    f.severity,
    v.recommended_action,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.last_seen > DATEADD('day', -7, CURRENT_DATE()) 
            THEN 'NEW_CRITICAL'
        WHEN f.last_seen BETWEEN DATEADD('day', -30, CURRENT_DATE()) AND DATEADD('day', -7, CURRENT_DATE())
            THEN 'PERSISTENT_CRITICAL'
        ELSE 'STALE_CRITICAL'
    END AS finding_status
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_bitsight_findings f
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_bitsight_risk_vectors v
    ON f.risk_vector_label = v.risk_vector_label
WHERE f.severity = 'CRITICAL'
  AND f.last_seen >= DATEADD('month', -3, CURRENT_DATE());

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_DEFE.name: VW_DEFENDER_OS_SECURITY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_DEFE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_defender_os_security

AS
SELECT
    operating_system,
    os_version,
    COUNT(*) AS device_count,
    COUNT_IF(compliance = 'Compliant') AS compliant_devices,
    ROUND((compliant_devices * 100.0) / device_count, 2) AS compliance_pct,
    COUNT_IF(device_state = 'Active') AS active_devices,
    MAX(last_status_update) AS last_reported
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_defender_endpoints
GROUP BY operating_system, os_version;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FARR.name: VW_FARRANS_COMPLIANCE_THRESHOLDS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FARR.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_farrans_compliance_thresholds

AS
SELECT
    'PROTECTION_COVERAGE_THRESHOLD' AS parameter_name,
    95 AS parameter_value,
    'Minimum acceptable endpoint protection coverage percentage' AS description
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'HEALTHY_AGENT_THRESHOLD',
    90,
    'Minimum acceptable percentage of healthy agents'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'INACTIVE_ENDPOINT_THRESHOLD',
    30,
    'Maximum allowed days since last activity'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'CRITICAL_INACTIVE_ALERT_THRESHOLD',
    5,
    'Maximum percentage of endpoints inactive >30 days';

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FIXE.name: VW_FIXEDVULN_OS_TRENDS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FIXE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_fixedvuln_os_trends

AS
SELECT
    e.os,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', e.last_fixed) AS fix_month,
    v.severity,
    COUNT(*) AS vulnerabilities_fixed,
    AVG(e.remediation_days) AS avg_remediation_days,
    COUNT_IF(e.times_reopened > 0) AS reopened_count,
    reopened_count * 100.0 / vulnerabilities_fixed AS reopen_rate_pct,
    LAG(vulnerabilities_fixed) OVER (PARTITION BY e.os, v.severity ORDER BY fix_month) AS prev_month_count,
    vulnerabilities_fixed - prev_month_count AS monthly_change
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_remediation_events e
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_fixed_vulnerabilities v 
    ON e.qid = v.qid
GROUP BY e.os, fix_month, v.severity;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_HARD.name: VW_HARDWARE_INVENTORY_SUMMARY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_HARD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_hardware_inventory_summary

AS
SELECT
    organisation,
    COUNT(*) AS total_devices,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'Active') AS active_devices,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'Inactive') AS inactive_devices,
    COUNT_IF(last_scanned < DATEADD(month, -1, CURRENT_DATE())) AS stale_records,
    ROUND(active_devices * 100.0 / total_devices, 2) AS active_percentage,
    CASE 
        WHEN active_percentage >= 95 THEN 'Compliant'
        WHEN active_percentage >= 90 THEN 'Warning'
        ELSE 'Non-Compliant'
    END AS compliance_status
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_hardware_inventory
GROUP BY organisation;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CROW.name: VW_CROWDSTRIKE_COVERAGE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CROW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_crowdstrike_coverage

AS
WITH total_endpoints AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT host_id) AS total
    FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.crowdstrike_endpoints
),
active_endpoints AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE(last_seen) AS report_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT host_id) AS active_count
    FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.crowdstrike_endpoints
    WHERE is_active
    GROUP BY report_date
)
SELECT
    a.report_date,
    a.active_count,
    t.total AS total_endpoints,
    ROUND((a.active_count * 100.0) / t.total, 2) AS coverage_pct,
    ROUND((a.active_count * 100.0) / t.total - 98, 2) AS gap_to_target,
    CASE 
        WHEN coverage_pct >= 98 THEN 'Compliant'
        WHEN coverage_pct >= 95 THEN 'Warning'
        ELSE 'Non-Compliant'
    END AS compliance_status,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS snapshot_ts
FROM active_endpoints a
CROSS JOIN total_endpoints t;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CYBE.name: VW_CYBELANGEL_COMPLIANCE_SETTINGS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CYBE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_cybelangel_compliance_settings

AS
SELECT
    'CRITICAL_SEVERITY_RESPONSE_SLA' AS parameter_name,
    7 AS parameter_value,
    'Max days to resolve critical severity alerts' AS description
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'HIGH_SEVERITY_RESPONSE_SLA',
    14,
    'Max days to resolve high severity alerts'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'PASSWORD_EXPOSURE_THRESHOLD',
    10,
    'Critical threshold for exposed passwords count'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'DOMAIN_EXPOSURE_THRESHOLD',
    5,
    'Critical threshold for exposed domains count';

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FARR.name: VW_FARRANS_INACTIVE_ALERTS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FARR.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_farrans_inactive_alerts

AS
SELECT
    e.endpoint_name,
    e.os,
    e.protection,
    h.health_status,
    h.last_active,
    DATEDIFF('day', h.last_active, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_inactive,
    CASE
        WHEN days_inactive > 30 THEN 'CRITICAL: Inactive >30 days'
        WHEN days_inactive > 14 THEN 'HIGH: Inactive 15-30 days'
        ELSE 'MEDIUM: Inactive 8-14 days'
    END AS alert_severity,
    CASE
        WHEN NOT CONTAINS(e.protection, 'Intercept X') THEN 'UNPROTECTED_ENDPOINT'
        ELSE 'INACTIVE_ENDPOINT'
    END AS alert_type
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_farrans_endpoints e
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_farrans_health h 
    ON e.endpoint_name = h.endpoint_name
WHERE DATEDIFF('day', h.last_active, CURRENT_DATE()) > 7;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FARR.name: VW_FARRANS_USER_ACTIVITY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FARR.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_farrans_user_activity

AS
SELECT
    last_user,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    COUNT_IF(CONTAINS(protection, 'Intercept X')) AS protected_count,
    COUNT_IF(NOT CONTAINS(protection, 'Intercept X')) AS unprotected_count,
    COUNT_IF(health_status = 'Healthy') AS healthy_count,
    MIN(last_active) AS first_activity,
    MAX(last_active) AS last_activity,
    DATEDIFF('day', last_activity, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_since_last_activity,
    ROUND(protected_count * 100.0 / endpoint_count, 2) AS protection_rate
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_farrans_health h
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_farrans_endpoints e 
    ON h.endpoint_name = e.endpoint_name
WHERE last_user IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY last_user;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_LEVI.name: VW_LEVIAT_ACCOUNT_HEALTH
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_LEVI.definition:

AS

    COUNT(*) AS total_accounts,

    ROUND(locked_accounts * 100.0 / total_accounts, 1) AS locked_account_pct,

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_LICE.name: VW_LICENSE_COMPLIANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_LICE.definition:

AS

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_QUAL.name: VW_QUALYS_HOST_COMPLIANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_QUAL.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_qualys_host_compliance

AS

    COUNT(*) AS host_count,
    COUNT_IF(last_vm_auth_scan_date >= DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE())) AS compliant_hosts,
    COUNT_IF(last_vm_auth_scan_date < DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE())) AS non_compliant_hosts,
    ROUND(compliant_hosts * 100.0 / host_count, 2) AS compliance_pct,
    AVG(DATEDIFF(day, last_vm_auth_scan_date, CURRENT_DATE())) AS avg_days_since_scan,
    COUNT_IF(NOT inscope) AS out_of_scope,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.qualys_host_data
GROUP BY host_os;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SYMA.name: VW_SYMANTEC_ANALYSIS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SYMA.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SYMANTEC_ANALYSIS AS

-- Simple, efficient view focusing on threat data with limited joins
SELECT
    -- Threat information
    t.DATESEEN,
    t.TYPE,
    t.DEVICE_NAME,
    t.USER_NAME,
    t.FEATURE_NAME,
    t.FILE_NAME,
    t.THREAT_NAME,
    t.TYPE_1 AS THREAT_TYPE,
    t.DEVICE_GROUP,
    
    -- Threat categorization
    CASE
        WHEN CONTAINS(t.THREAT_NAME, 'Trojan') THEN 'Trojan'
        WHEN CONTAINS(t.THREAT_NAME, 'Adware') THEN 'Adware'
        WHEN CONTAINS(t.THREAT_NAME, 'Spyware') THEN 'Spyware'
        WHEN CONTAINS(t.THREAT_NAME, 'Worm') THEN 'Worm'
        WHEN CONTAINS(t.THREAT_NAME, 'Virus') THEN 'Virus'
        WHEN CONTAINS(t.THREAT_NAME, 'Rootkit') THEN 'Rootkit'
        WHEN CONTAINS(t.THREAT_NAME, 'Ransomware') THEN 'Ransomware'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS THREAT_CATEGORY,
    
    -- Detection type categorization
    CASE
        WHEN t.TYPE_1 = 'HOST_FILE_DETECTION' THEN 'File-Based Threat'
        WHEN t.TYPE_1 = 'HOST_APP_DETECTION' THEN 'Application Threat'
        WHEN t.TYPE_1 = 'HOST_MEM_DETECTION' THEN 'Memory-Based Threat'
        ELSE t.TYPE_1
    END AS DETECTION_CATEGORY,
    
    -- Basic computer information via simple LEFT JOIN
    c.OPERATING_SYSTEM,
    c.MALWARE_PROTECTION,
    c.DEVICE_SECURITY_STATUS,
    c.HAS_UNRESOLVED_THREATS,
    c.GROUP_NAME,
    c.SYMANTEC_OPCO
    
FROM 
    DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.SYMANTEC_THREATS t
LEFT JOIN 
    DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.SYMANTEC_COMPUTERS c
    ON t.DEVICE_NAME = c.COMPUTER_NAME
;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_TRELLIX_AGENT_HEALTH
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_QUAL.name: VW_QUALYS_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_QUAL.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_qualys_executive_summary

AS
SELECT
    'VULNERABILITY_MANAGEMENT' AS metric_category,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.qualys_host_data WHERE inscope) AS inscope_hosts,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(last_vm_auth_scan_date >= DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE())) 
        FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.qualys_host_data WHERE inscope) AS scanned_hosts,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(severity_level >= 4) 
        FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.qualys_vuln_kb_data) AS critical_vulns,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(exploitable) 
        FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.qualys_vuln_kb_data) AS exploitable_vulns,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(severity_level >= 4 AND NOT patchable) 
        FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.qualys_vuln_kb_data) AS critical_unpatched,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SENT.name: VW_SENTINEL_ACTIVITY_ANALYSIS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SENT.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_sentinel_activity_analysis

AS

    domain,

    COUNT(*) AS total_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(last_active >= DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE())) AS active_1d,

    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SOPH.name: VW_SOPHOS_ENDPOINT_HEALTH
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SOPH.definition:

    COUNT(*) AS total_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(health_status = 'Healthy') AS healthy_endpoints,

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ZSCA.name: VW_ZSCALER_SECURITY_ALERTS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ZSCA.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_zscaler_security_alerts

AS
SELECT
    'INACTIVE_ENDPOINT' AS alert_type,
    device_hostname,
    user_email,
    last_connected,
    DATEDIFF('day', last_connected, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_inactive,
    'No Zscaler connection detected' AS description
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_zscaler_endpoints
WHERE days_inactive > (SELECT parameter_value 
                      FROM DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_zscaler_compliance_settings 
                      WHERE parameter_name = 'INACTIVITY_THRESHOLD_DAYS')
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'FREQUENT_THREATS' AS alert_type,
    device_hostname,
    user_email,
    MAX(threat_date) AS last_threat,
    COUNT(*) AS threat_count_24h,
    'Excessive threat activity detected' AS description
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_zscaler_threats
WHERE threat_date >= DATEADD(hour, -24, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())
GROUP BY device_hostname, user_email
HAVING threat_count_24h > (SELECT parameter_value 
                          FROM DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_zscaler_compliance_settings 
                          WHERE parameter_name = 'THREAT_ALERT_THRESHOLD');

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_BITS.name: VW_BITSIGHT_RISK_TREND
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_BITS.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_bitsight_risk_trend

AS
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', last_seen) AS month,
    v.category,
    COUNT(DISTINCT domain_name) AS vendors_affected,
    COUNT(*) AS critical_findings,
    LAG(critical_findings) OVER (PARTITION BY v.category ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_findings,
    critical_findings - prev_month_findings AS monthly_change
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_bitsight_findings f
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_bitsight_risk_vectors v
    ON f.risk_vector_label = v.risk_vector_label
WHERE severity = 'CRITICAL'
GROUP BY month, v.category;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_DEFE.name: VW_DEFENDER_AGENT_HEALTH

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_SYMANTEC_THREAT_SUMMARY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:

    COALESCE(e.symantec_opco, 'UNKNOWN') AS opco,
