    AVG(DATEDIFF('hour', t.threat_date, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AS avg_hours_since_detection,

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_HOST.name: VW_HOSTS_SCAN_PERFORMANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_HOST.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_hosts_scan_performance

AS
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('week', scan_date) AS scan_week,
    scan_type,
    COUNT(*) AS scan_count,
    AVG(scan_duration_seconds) AS avg_duration_seconds,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY scan_duration_seconds) AS p90_duration,
    MIN(scan_duration_seconds) AS min_duration,
    MAX(scan_duration_seconds) AS max_duration,
    COUNT_IF(scan_duration_seconds <= 300) AS fast_scans,
    COUNT_IF(scan_duration_seconds > 300 AND scan_duration_seconds <= 900) AS medium_scans,
    COUNT_IF(scan_duration_seconds > 900) AS slow_scans
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_scan_events
WHERE scan_date >= DATEADD('month', -6, CURRENT_DATE())
GROUP BY scan_week, scan_type;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_MCAF.name: VW_MCAFEE_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_MCAF.definition:

AS

    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_mcafee_endpoints) AS total_endpoints,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(compliance_status = 'Compliant') FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_mcafee_endpoints) AS compliant_endpoints,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(last_communication >= DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_DATE())) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_mcafee_endpoints) AS active_endpoints,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(esp_patch_version < 5) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_mcafee_endpoints) AS outdated_patches,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_mcafee_security_alerts) AS active_alerts,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLU.name: VW_SPLUNK_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLU.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_splunk_executive_summary

AS
SELECT
    'SIEM_MONITORING' AS metric_category,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_splunk_hosts) AS total_hosts,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(last_seen >= DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE())) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_splunk_hosts) AS active_hosts_1d,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_splunk_alerts) AS total_alerts,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(state = 'Open') FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_splunk_alerts) AS open_alerts,
    (SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF('minute', created_time, resolved_time)) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_splunk_alerts WHERE resolved_time IS NOT NULL) AS avg_resolution_min,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF('minute', created_time, resolved_time) <= 240) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_splunk_alerts WHERE resolved_time IS NOT NULL) AS resolved_within_4h,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(priority = 1) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_splunk_alerts) AS critical_alerts,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FIXE.name: VW_FIXEDVULN_COMPLIANCE_THRESHOLDS

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FIXE.name: VW_FIXEDVULN_EFFICIENCY_TRENDS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FIXE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_fixedvuln_efficiency_trends

AS
WITH monthly_data AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', e.last_fixed) AS fix_month,
        v.severity,
        AVG(e.remediation_days) AS avg_remediation_days,
        MEDIAN(e.remediation_days) AS median_remediation_days,
        COUNT(*) AS vulnerabilities_fixed
    FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_remediation_events e
    JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_fixed_vulnerabilities v 
        ON e.qid = v.qid
    GROUP BY fix_month, v.severity
)
SELECT
    fix_month,
    severity,
    avg_remediation_days,
    median_remediation_days,
    vulnerabilities_fixed,
    LAG(avg_remediation_days) OVER (PARTITION BY severity ORDER BY fix_month) AS prev_avg,
    avg_remediation_days - prev_avg AS avg_change,
    LAG(median_remediation_days) OVER (PARTITION BY severity ORDER BY fix_month) AS prev_median,
    median_remediation_days - prev_median AS median_change
FROM monthly_data;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_TRENDMICRO_AGENT_HEALTH
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:

    group_path AS opco,
    COUNT_IF(security_update_status = 'Up-to-Date') AS security_updated,
    COUNT_IF(software_update_status = 'Up-to-Date') AS software_updated,

    ROUND(security_updated * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_agents, 0), 2) AS security_update_pct,
    ROUND(software_updated * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_agents, 0), 2) AS software_update_pct,

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_TRENDMICRO_EDR_COVERAGE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_trendmicro_edr_coverage AS
SELECT
    group_path AS opco,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'Managed (Online)') AS active_endpoints,
    COUNT(*) AS total_endpoints,
    ROUND(active_endpoints * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_endpoints, 0), 2) AS coverage_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_trendmicro_endpoints

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_TRENDMICRO_SECURITY_UPDATES
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:

SELECT
    group_path AS opco,
    FLOOR(version) AS major_version,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    MIN(version_release_date) AS oldest_version_date,
    MAX(version_release_date) AS newest_version_date,
    COUNT_IF(security_update_status = 'Out-of-Date') AS outdated_count,
    ROUND(outdated_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(endpoint_count, 0), 2) AS outdated_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_trendmicro_endpoints
GROUP BY group_path, major_version;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_ZEROFOX_ASSET_EXPOSURE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_zerofox_asset_exposure AS
SELECT
    z.asset_id,
    z.name AS asset_name,
    z.opco,
    z.type AS asset_type,
    z.domains,
    COUNT(a.alert_id) AS alert_count_90d,
    COUNT_IF(a.severity = 'high') AS high_severity_count,
    COUNT_IF(a.status = 'open') AS open_alerts,
    MAX(a.created_at) AS last_alert,
    DATEDIFF(day, last_alert, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_since_last_alert,
    CASE
        WHEN high_severity_count > 5 THEN 'CRITICAL'
        WHEN alert_count_90d > 10 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN alert_count_90d > 5 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS exposure_level,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_zerofox_assets z
LEFT JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_zerofox_alerts a 
    ON z.asset_id = a.asset_id
    AND a.created_at >= DATEADD(day, -90, CURRENT_DATE())
GROUP BY z.asset_id, z.name, z.opco, z.type, z.domains;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_LEVI.name: VW_LEVIAT_SECURITY_EVENTS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_LEVI.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_leviat_security_events

AS
SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC('hour', event_timestamp) AS event_hour,
    event_type,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,  -- Usar conteo de eventos
    COUNT_IF(lockout_date IS NOT NULL) AS lockout_events,
    COUNT(DISTINCT username) AS affected_users
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_leviat_security_events
GROUP BY 1, 2;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SNOW.name: VW_SNOW_OS_DISTRIBUTION
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SNOW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_snow_os_distribution

AS
SELECT
    operating_system,
    client_version,
    COUNT(*) AS device_count,
    COUNT_IF(last_scanned >= DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE())) AS scanned_30d,
    COUNT_IF(in_scope) AS in_scope_count,
    COUNT_IF(iaas_licensed) AS licensed_count,
    MIN(last_scanned) AS oldest_scan,
    MAX(last_scanned) AS newest_scan,
    ROUND(scanned_30d * 100.0 / device_count, 2) AS scan_coverage_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_snow_devices
GROUP BY operating_system, client_version;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ZSCA.name: VW_ZSCALER_AGENT_HEALTH
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ZSCA.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_zscaler_agent_health

AS
WITH agent_health AS (
    SELECT
        device_hostname,
        -- Placeholder logic - assumes agent is healthy if connected in last 7 days 
        -- and client version matches latest (requires version reference table)
        CASE 
            WHEN last_connected >= DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_DATE()) 
                AND client_version = (SELECT MAX(client_version) 
                                     FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_zscaler_endpoints) 
            THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS healthy_agent,
        -- Placeholder for SOX classification
        CASE WHEN device_type ILIKE '%server%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_sox_system
    FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_zscaler_endpoints
)
SELECT
    'ALL_SYSTEMS' AS health_scope,
    COUNT(device_hostname) AS total_agents,
    SUM(healthy_agent) AS healthy_agents,
    ROUND(healthy_agents * 100.0 / total_agents, 2) AS health_pct,
    ROUND((total_agents - healthy_agents) * 100.0 / total_agents, 2) AS non_compliant_pct
FROM agent_health
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'SOX_SYSTEMS' AS health_scope,
    COUNT(device_hostname) AS total_agents,
    SUM(healthy_agent) AS healthy_agents,
    ROUND(healthy_agents * 100.0 / total_agents, 2) AS health_pct,
    ROUND((total_agents - healthy_agents) * 100.0 / total_agents, 2) AS non_compliant_pct
FROM agent_health
WHERE is_sox_system = 1;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OBJE.name: VW_OBJECTS_SUMMARY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OBJE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OBJECTS_SUMMARY AS
SELECT 
    table_catalog     AS environment,
    table_schema      AS schema_name,
    table_name,
    table_type,
    created,
    last_altered
FROM 
    information_schema.tables
WHERE 
    table_schema = 'SECURITY_ANALYTICS';

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SNOW.name: VW_SNOW_INVENTORY_COMPLETENESS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SNOW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_snow_inventory_completeness

AS
SELECT
    'ALL_DEVICES' AS scope,
    COUNT(*) AS total_devices,
    COUNT_IF(manufacturer IS NOT NULL) AS devices_with_manufacturer,
    COUNT_IF(model IS NOT NULL) AS devices_with_model,
    COUNT_IF(operating_system IS NOT NULL) AS devices_with_os,
    COUNT_IF(last_scanned IS NOT NULL) AS devices_with_last_scan,
    COUNT_IF(in_scope) AS in_scope_devices,
    ROUND(devices_with_manufacturer * 100.0 / total_devices, 2) AS manufacturer_completeness_pct,
    ROUND(devices_with_model * 100.0 / total_devices, 2) AS model_completeness_pct,
    ROUND(devices_with_os * 100.0 / total_devices, 2) AS os_completeness_pct,
    ROUND(in_scope_devices * 100.0 / total_devices, 2) AS in_scope_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_snow_devices;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SNOW.name: VW_SNOW_SECURITY_COVERAGE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SNOW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_snow_security_coverage

AS
SELECT
    environment,
    COUNT(*) AS total_devices,
    COUNT_IF(in_scope) AS in_scope_devices,
    COUNT_IF(NOT in_scope) AS out_of_scope_devices,
    COUNT_IF(last_scanned >= DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE()) AND in_scope) AS compliant_and_covered,
    ROUND(in_scope_devices * 100.0 / total_devices, 2) AS coverage_pct,
    ROUND(compliant_and_covered * 100.0 / in_scope_devices, 2) AS compliant_coverage_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_snow_devices
GROUP BY environment;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SOPH.name: VW_SOPHOS_OS_PROTECTION
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SOPH.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_sophos_os_protection

AS
SELECT
    os,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    COUNT_IF(health_status = 'Healthy') AS healthy_count,
    COUNT_IF(protection = 'Protected') AS protected_count,
    COUNT_IF(last_active >= DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_DATE())) AS active_7d,
    COUNT_IF(last_active < DATEADD(day, -14, CURRENT_DATE())) AS inactive_14d,
    ROUND(protected_count * 100.0 / endpoint_count, 2) AS protection_pct,
    AVG(DATEDIFF('day', last_active, CURRENT_DATE())) AS avg_days_inactive,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_sophos_endpoints
GROUP BY os;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SNOW.name: VW_SNOW_COMPLIANCE_STATUS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SNOW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_snow_compliance_status

AS
SELECT
    environment,
    device_type,
    classification,
    COUNT(*) AS device_count,
    COUNT_IF(last_scanned >= DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE())) AS compliant_devices,
    COUNT_IF(last_scanned < DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE())) AS non_compliant_devices,
    COUNT_IF(NOT in_scope) AS out_of_scope_devices,
    COUNT_IF(TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(client_version, '.', 1) AS NUMBER) < 6) AS outdated_clients,
    ROUND(compliant_devices * 100.0 / device_count, 2) AS compliance_pct,
    AVG(DATEDIFF('day', last_scanned, CURRENT_DATE())) AS avg_days_since_scan,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_snow_devices
GROUP BY environment, device_type, classification;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ANCO.name: VW_ANCON_ACCOUNT_COMPLIANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ANCO.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_ancon_account_compliance

AS
SELECT
    username AS user_id,
    email_address,
    disabled AS is_account_disabled,
    account_is_locked_out AS is_locked_out,
    password_age_days,
    bad_password_attempts,
    DATEDIFF('days', last_logon_date, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_since_last_login,

    /* Compliance evaluation flags */
    CASE
        WHEN password_age_days > 90 THEN 'Password Policy Violation'
        WHEN bad_password_attempts > 5 THEN 'Excessive Failed Logins'
        WHEN days_since_last_login > 60 THEN 'Inactive Account'
        ELSE 'Compliant'
    END AS compliance_status,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS snapshot_ts
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_ancon_users;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_BITS.name: VW_BITSIGHT_RISK_COMPLIANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_BITS.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_bitsight_risk_compliance

AS
SELECT
    v.domain_name,
    v.risk_rating,
    v.target_status,
    f.tags AS vendor_tags,
    f.last_finding_date,
    CASE
        WHEN v.risk_rating = 'HIGH' THEN 'REQUIRES_IMMEDIATE_ATTENTION'
        WHEN v.risk_rating = 'MEDIUM' THEN 'REQUIRES_PLANNED_REMEDIATION'
        ELSE 'ACCEPTABLE_RISK'
    END AS action_status,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS snapshot_ts
FROM DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_bitsight_vendor_risk v
JOIN (
    SELECT domain_name, MAX(last_seen) AS last_finding_date, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT tags) AS tags
    FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_bitsight_findings
    GROUP BY domain_name
) f ON v.domain_name = f.domain_name;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_BITS.name: VW_BITSIGHT_RISK_VECTOR_ANALYSIS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_BITS.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_bitsight_risk_vector_analysis

AS
SELECT
    v.category,
    f.risk_vector_label,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.domain_name) AS affected_vendors,
    COUNT(*) AS total_findings,
    ROUND(AVG(CASE severity
        WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 3
        WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2
        WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END), 2) AS avg_severity_score,
    v.recommended_action
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_bitsight_findings f
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_bitsight_risk_vectors v
    ON f.risk_vector_label = v.risk_vector_label
GROUP BY v.category, f.risk_vector_label, v.recommended_action;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CISC.name: VW_CISCO_AMP_COVERAGE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CISC.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CISCO_AMP_COVERAGE(
    REPORT_DATE,
    ACTIVE_COUNT,
    INACTIVE_COUNT,
    TOTAL_ENDPOINTS,
    COVERAGE_PCT,
    GAP_TO_TARGET,
    COMPLIANCE_STATUS,
    SNAPSHOT_TS
) 
AS
WITH endpoint_counts AS (
    SELECT
        DATE(Last_Seen) AS report_date,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Is_Active = TRUE THEN Connector_GUID END) AS active_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Is_Active = FALSE THEN Connector_GUID END) AS inactive_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT Connector_GUID) AS total_daily_endpoints
    FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.CISCO_AMP_data
    GROUP BY report_date
),
total_endpoints AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Connector_GUID) AS total
    FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.CISCO_AMP_data
)
SELECT
    e.report_date,
    e.active_count,
    e.inactive_count,
    t.total AS total_endpoints,
    ROUND((e.active_count * 100.0) / NULLIF(t.total, 0), 2) AS coverage_pct,
    ROUND((e.active_count * 100.0) / NULLIF(t.total, 0) - 98, 2) AS gap_to_target,
    CASE
        WHEN (e.active_count * 100.0) / NULLIF(t.total, 0) >= 98 THEN 'Compliant'
        WHEN (e.active_count * 100.0) / NULLIF(t.total, 0) >= 95 THEN 'Warning'
        ELSE 'Non-Compliant'
    END AS compliance_status,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS snapshot_ts
FROM endpoint_counts e
CROSS JOIN total_endpoints t;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CISC.name: VW_CISCO_AMP_OS_COVERAGE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CISC.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_cisco_amp_os_coverage

AS
SELECT
    Operating_System,
    COUNT(DISTINCT Connector_GUID) AS total_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(Is_Active) AS active_endpoints,
    ROUND(active_endpoints * 100.0 / total_endpoints, 2) AS coverage_pct,
    COUNT_IF(Connector_Version < '8.0.0') AS outdated_versions,
    ROUND(outdated_versions * 100.0 / total_endpoints, 2) AS outdated_pct
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.CISCO_AMP_data
GROUP BY Operating_System;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CISC.name: VW_CISCO_AMP_VERSION_COMPLIANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CISC.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_cisco_amp_version_compliance

AS
SELECT
    Connector_Version,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    MIN(Last_Seen) AS oldest_seen,
    MAX(Last_Seen) AS newest_seen,
    CASE
        WHEN Connector_Version >= '8.0.0' THEN 'Compliant'
        WHEN Connector_Version >= '7.0.0' THEN 'Warning'
        ELSE 'Non-Compliant'
    END AS compliance_status
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.CISCO_AMP_data
GROUP BY Connector_Version;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CROW.name: VW_CROWDSTRIKE_COMPLIANCE_SETTINGS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CROW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_crowdstrike_compliance_settings

AS
SELECT
    'EDR_COVERAGE_TARGET' AS parameter_name,
    98 AS parameter_value,
    'Minimum required EDR coverage percentage' AS description
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'VERSION_EOL_THRESHOLD_DAYS',
    30,
    'Days before EOL to flag as warning'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'USER_INACTIVITY_THRESHOLD',
    60,
    'Days without login to flag user account'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'ENDPOINT_INACTIVITY_THRESHOLD',
    30,
    'Days without activity to consider endpoint inactive';

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_DEFE.name: VW_DEFENDER_EDR_COVERAGE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_DEFE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_defender_edr_coverage

AS
SELECT
    'ALL_SYSTEMS' AS coverage_scope,
    COUNT(*) AS total_devices,
    COUNT_IF(compliance IS NOT NULL) AS devices_with_agent,
    devices_with_agent AS covered_devices,  -- All devices in this table have agents
    ROUND((devices_with_agent * 100.0) / total_devices, 2) AS coverage_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_defender_endpoints;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_DEFE.name: VW_DEFENDER_THREAT_SUMMARY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_DEFE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_defender_threat_summary

AS
SELECT
    threat_type,
    COUNT(*) AS threat_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) AS affected_devices,
    MIN(threat_date) AS first_detected,
    MAX(threat_date) AS last_detected,
    DATEDIFF('days', last_detected, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_since_last_incident
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_defender_threats
GROUP BY threat_type;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_SYMANTEC_HIGH_RISK_ENDPOINTS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_symantec_high_risk_endpoints AS
SELECT
    e.computer_name,
    e.symantec_opco AS opco,
    e.device_security_status,
    e.operating_system,
    e.last_scan_time,
    e.last_update_time,
    COUNT(t.threat_id) AS threat_count_30d,
    MAX(t.threat_date) AS latest_threat,
    CASE 
        WHEN threat_count_30d > 3 THEN 'CRITICAL'
        WHEN threat_count_30d > 0 THEN 'HIGH'
        ELSE 'NORMAL'
    END AS risk_level,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_symantec_endpoints e
LEFT JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_symantec_threats t
  ON e.computer_name = t.computer_name
  AND t.threat_date >= DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE())
WHERE e.device_security_status != 'Protected'
   OR EXISTS ( 
        SELECT 1 
        FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_symantec_threats t2
        WHERE t2.computer_name = e.computer_name
          AND t2.threat_date >= DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE())
      ) 
GROUP BY 
    e.computer_name, 
    e.symantec_opco,
    e.device_security_status, 
    e.operating_system, 
    e.last_scan_time,
    e.last_update_time;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_THREATINTEL_RECENT_CRITICAL
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD_THREATINTEL_RECENT_CRITICAL(
    EVENT_KEY,
    EVENT_DATE,
    OPCO,
    SOURCE,
    ASSET_TYPE,
    RULE_GROUP_NAME,
    TAKEDOWN_SUCCESSFUL,
    DAYS_SINCE_EVENT,
    THREAT_LEVEL,
    SNAPSHOT_DATE
) AS
SELECT
    event_key,
    event_date::DATE AS event_date,  -- Simple cast to DATE
    opco,
    source,
    asset_type,
    rule_group_name,
    takedown_successful,
    DATEDIFF(day, event_date::DATE, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_since_event,
    CASE 
        WHEN NOT takedown_successful AND DATEDIFF(day, event_date::DATE, CURRENT_DATE()) <= 7 THEN 'CRITICAL'
        WHEN NOT takedown_successful AND DATEDIFF(day, event_date::DATE, CURRENT_DATE()) <= 30 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN NOT takedown_successful THEN 'MEDIUM'
        WHEN takedown_successful AND DATEDIFF(day, event_date::DATE, CURRENT_DATE()) <= 7 THEN 'LOW'
        ELSE 'RESOLVED'
    END AS threat_level,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_threat_intel_events
WHERE event_date::DATE >= DATEADD(day, -90, CURRENT_DATE())  -- Extended from 30 to 90 days
ORDER BY 
    CASE threat_level
        WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1
        WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2
        WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3
        WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4
        WHEN 'RESOLVED' THEN 5
    END,
    days_since_event ASC;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_TRELLIX_AMCORE_COMPLIANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_trellix_amcore_compliance AS
SELECT
    domain_name AS opco,
    FLOOR(amcore_version) AS major_version,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    MIN(amcore_date) AS oldest_version_date,
    MAX(amcore_date) AS newest_version_date,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF(day, amcore_date, CURRENT_DATE()) > 30) AS outdated_count,
    ROUND(outdated_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(endpoint_count, 0), 2) AS outdated_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_trellix_endpoints
GROUP BY domain_name, major_version;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ZSCA.name: VW_ZSCALER_ENDPOINT_RISK
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ZSCA.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_zscaler_endpoint_risk

AS
SELECT
    e.device_hostname,  -- Corregido: device.hostname → device_hostname
    e.user_email,
    e.device_type,
    e.os_version,
    e.client_version,
    e.last_connected,
    DATEDIFF('day', e.last_connected, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_inactive,
    COALESCE(t.threat_count, 0) AS threat_count_30d,  -- Usar el conteo directo de la subconsulta
    CASE
        WHEN days_inactive > 30 THEN 'CRITICAL: Inactive >30 days'
        WHEN days_inactive > 7 THEN 'HIGH: Inactive 7-30 days'
        WHEN COALESCE(t.threat_count, 0) > 10 THEN 'HIGH: Frequent threats'
        WHEN COALESCE(t.threat_count, 0) > 5 THEN 'MEDIUM: Elevated threats'
        ELSE 'LOW: Normal activity'
    END AS risk_level
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_zscaler_endpoints e
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        device_hostname, 
        COUNT(*) AS threat_count
    FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_zscaler_threats
    WHERE threat_date >= DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE())
    GROUP BY device_hostname
) t ON e.device_hostname = t.device_hostname;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FIXE.name: VW_FIXEDVULN_AGE_ANALYSIS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FIXE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_fixedvuln_age_analysis

AS
SELECT
    v.severity,
    FLOOR(e.remediation_days / 7) * 7 AS days_range_start,
    days_range_start + 6 AS days_range_end,
    COUNT(*) AS vulnerability_count,
    AVG(e.remediation_days) AS avg_days_in_range,
    MIN(e.remediation_days) AS min_days,
    MAX(e.remediation_days) AS max_days
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_remediation_events e
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_fixed_vulnerabilities v 
    ON e.qid = v.qid
GROUP BY v.severity, days_range_start, days_range_end
ORDER BY v.severity, days_range_start;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_SYMANTEC_ENDPOINT_HEALTH
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_symantec_endpoint_health AS
SELECT
    symantec_opco AS opco,
    device_security_status,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    AVG(DATEDIFF('day', last_scan_time, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AS avg_days_since_scan,
    COUNT_IF(last_update_time < DATEADD(day, -14, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AS stale_agents,
    ROUND(stale_agents * 100.0 / NULLIF(endpoint_count, 0), 2) AS stale_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_symantec_endpoints
GROUP BY opco, device_security_status;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_THREATINTEL_TAKEDOWN_EFFECTIVENESS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_threatintel_takedown_effectiveness AS
SELECT
    source,
    asset_type,
    COUNT_IF(takedown_successful) AS successful_takedowns,
    COUNT(*) AS total_events,
    ROUND(successful_takedowns * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_events, 0), 2) AS success_rate,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_threat_intel_events
WHERE event_date >= DATEADD(month, -6, CURRENT_DATE())
GROUP BY source, asset_type;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_TRELLIX_COMMUNICATION_STATUS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_trellix_communication_status AS
SELECT
    domain_name AS opco,
    os_type,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF(day, last_communication, CURRENT_DATE()) <= 1) AS active_24h,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF(day, last_communication, CURRENT_DATE()) BETWEEN 2 AND 7) AS active_7d,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF(day, last_communication, CURRENT_DATE()) > 7) AS stale_7d,
    MAX(DATEDIFF(day, last_communication, CURRENT_DATE())) AS max_days_inactive,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_trellix_endpoints
GROUP BY domain_name, os_type;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_HOST.name: VW_HOSTS_SCAN_COVERAGE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_HOST.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_hosts_scan_coverage

AS
SELECT
    a.bu,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.asset_id) AS total_assets,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.asset_id) AS scanned_assets,
    scanned_assets AS assets_scanned_last_30d,
    ROUND(scanned_assets * 100.0 / total_assets, 2) AS scan_coverage_pct,
    COUNT_IF(s.scan_type = 'Vulnerability') AS vuln_scans,
    COUNT_IF(s.scan_type = 'Authenticated') AS auth_scans,
    AVG(s.scan_duration_seconds) AS avg_scan_duration,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF('day', s.scan_date, CURRENT_DATE()) <= 7) AS scanned_7d,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF('day', s.scan_date, CURRENT_DATE()) > 7 AND DATEDIFF('day', s.scan_date, CURRENT_DATE()) <= 30) AS scanned_8_30d,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF('day', s.scan_date, CURRENT_DATE()) > 30) AS scanned_over_30d
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_host_assets a
LEFT JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_scan_events s 
    ON a.asset_id = s.asset_id
    AND s.scan_date >= DATEADD('day', -30, CURRENT_DATE())
GROUP BY a.bu;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_LEVI.name: VW_LEVIAT_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_LEVI.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_leviat_executive_summary

AS
SELECT
    'USER_ACCOUNT_SECURITY' AS metric_category,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_leviat_users) AS total_accounts,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(account_is_locked_out) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_leviat_users) AS locked_accounts,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(last_logon_date < DATEADD('day', -90, CURRENT_DATE())) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_leviat_users) AS inactive_accounts,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(password_age_days > 90) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_leviat_users) AS expired_passwords,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_leviat_security_alerts) AS active_alerts,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_QUAL.name: VW_QUALYS_PATCH_COMPLIANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_QUAL.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_qualys_patch_compliance

AS
SELECT
    category,
    COUNT(*) AS total_vulns,
    COUNT_IF(patchable) AS patchable_vulns,
    COUNT_IF(NOT patchable) AS non_patchable_vulns,
    ROUND(patchable_vulns * 100.0 / total_vulns, 2) AS patchable_pct,
    COUNT_IF(severity_level >= 4 AND patchable) AS critical_patchable,
    COUNT_IF(severity_level >= 4 AND NOT patchable) AS critical_unpatchable,
    COUNT_IF(exploitable) AS exploitable_count,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.qualys_vuln_kb_data
GROUP BY category;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FARR.name: VW_FARRANS_HEALTH_SUMMARY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FARR.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_farrans_health_summary

AS
SELECT
    health_status,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF('day', last_active, CURRENT_DATE()) <= 7) AS active_7d,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF('day', last_active, CURRENT_DATE()) > 7 AND DATEDIFF('day', last_active, CURRENT_DATE()) <= 30) AS active_8_30d,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF('day', last_active, CURRENT_DATE()) > 30) AS inactive_30d,
    MIN(last_active) AS oldest_activity,
    MAX(last_active) AS recent_activity,
    ROUND(active_7d * 100.0 / endpoint_count, 2) AS active_7d_pct
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_farrans_health
GROUP BY health_status;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_ZEROFOX_ALERT_TRENDS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_zerofox_alert_trends AS
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', a.created_at) AS alert_date,
    z.opco,
    a.network_name,
    a.alert_type,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count,
    COUNT_IF(a.severity = 'high') AS high_severity_count,
    COUNT_IF(a.content_removed) AS removed_count,
    ROUND(removed_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(alert_count, 0), 2) AS removal_rate,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_zerofox_alerts a
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_zerofox_assets z 
    ON a.asset_id = z.asset_id
WHERE a.created_at >= DATEADD(month, -3, CURRENT_DATE())
GROUP BY alert_date, z.opco, a.network_name, a.alert_type;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_HOST.name: VW_HOSTS_INVENTORY_COMPLETENESS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_HOST.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_hosts_inventory_completeness

AS
SELECT
    'ALL_ASSETS' AS scope,
    COUNT(*) AS total_assets,
    COUNT_IF(ip IS NOT NULL) AS assets_with_ip,
    COUNT_IF(os IS NOT NULL AND os != '') AS assets_with_os,
    COUNT_IF(bu IS NOT NULL AND bu != '') AS assets_with_bu,
    COUNT_IF(last_activity IS NOT NULL) AS assets_with_activity,
    ROUND(assets_with_ip * 100.0 / total_assets, 2) AS ip_completeness_pct,
    ROUND(assets_with_os * 100.0 / total_assets, 2) AS os_completeness_pct,
    ROUND(assets_with_bu * 100.0 / total_assets, 2) AS bu_completeness_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_host_assets;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_INVE.name: VW_INVENTORY_COMPLIANCE_SETTINGS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_INVE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_inventory_compliance_settings

AS
SELECT
    'ACTIVE_DEVICE_TARGET' AS parameter_name,
    95 AS parameter_value,
    'Minimum required active devices percentage' AS description
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'MAX_SCAN_AGE_DAYS',
    30,
    'Maximum allowed days since last scan'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'RETIREMENT_THRESHOLD',
    90,
    'Inactive days before retirement consideration';

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_LEVI.name: VW_LEVIAT_ACTIVITY_TRENDS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_LEVI.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_leviat_activity_trends

AS
SELECT
    opco AS business_unit,
    DATE_TRUNC('week', last_logon_date) AS activity_week,
    COUNT(DISTINCT username) AS active_users,
    COUNT_IF(account_is_locked_out) AS locked_users,
    COUNT_IF(last_logon_date < DATEADD('month', -6, CURRENT_DATE())) AS dormant_users,
    COUNT_IF(last_logon_date >= DATEADD('day', -7, CURRENT_DATE())) AS active_7d
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_leviat_users
GROUP BY business_unit, activity_week;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SENT.name: VW_SENTINEL_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SENT.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_sentinel_executive_summary

AS
SELECT
    'EDR_COVERAGE' AS metric_category,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_sentinel_endpoints) AS total_endpoints,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(update_status) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_sentinel_endpoints) AS updated_agents,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(last_active >= DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_DATE())) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_sentinel_endpoints) AS active_endpoints,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(device_type = 'Server') FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_sentinel_endpoints) AS servers,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(device_type = 'Workstation') FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_sentinel_endpoints) AS workstations,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SNOW.name: VW_SNOW_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SNOW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_snow_executive_summary

AS
SELECT
    'DEVICE_INVENTORY' AS metric_category,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_snow_devices) AS total_devices,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(in_scope) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_snow_devices) AS in_scope_devices,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(last_scanned >= DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE())) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_snow_devices) AS scanned_30d,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(client_version, '.', 1) AS NUMBER) < 6) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_snow_devices) AS outdated_clients,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(status != 'Active') FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_snow_devices) AS inactive_devices,
    (SELECT AVG(DATEDIFF('day', last_scanned, CURRENT_DATE())) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_snow_devices) AS avg_days_since_scan,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ZSCA.name: VW_ZSCALER_THREAT_SUMMARY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ZSCA.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_zscaler_threat_summary

AS
SELECT
    DATE(threat_date) AS threat_day,
    threat_category,
    device_type,
    COUNT(threat_id) AS threat_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.device_hostname) AS affected_devices,
    ROUND(threat_count * 100.0 / MAX(total_devices.total), 2) AS threat_percentage
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_zscaler_threats t
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_zscaler_endpoints e 
    ON t.device_hostname = e.device_hostname
CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total 
    FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_zscaler_endpoints
) total_devices
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ANCO.name: VW_ANCON_SECURITY_ALERTS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ANCO.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_ancon_security_alerts 

AS
SELECT
    username,
    email_address,
    'Stale Password' AS alert_type,
    'Password unchanged for ' || password_age_days || ' days' AS description,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS alert_generated_time
    
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_ancon_users
WHERE password_age_days > 45  -- Warning before policy violation

UNION ALL

SELECT
    username,
    email_address,
    'Account Lockout Risk',
    bad_password_attempts || ' failed login attempts' AS description,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
    
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_ancon_users
WHERE bad_password_attempts BETWEEN 3 AND 5  -- Configurable threshold

UNION ALL

SELECT
    username,
    email_address,
    'Inactive Account',
    'No login for ' || DATEDIFF('days', last_logon_date, CURRENT_DATE()) || ' days' AS description,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()
    
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_ancon_users
WHERE last_logon_date < DATEADD('month', -3, CURRENT_DATE())
;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ANCO.name: VW_ANCON_SECURITY_METRICS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ANCO.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_ancon_security_metrics 

AS
SELECT
    'Password Health' AS metric_category,
    COUNT_IF(password_age_days > 90) AS expired_passwords,
    COUNT_IF(password_last_changed IS NULL) AS never_changed_passwords,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS metric_date
    
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_ancon_users

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'Account Security',
    COUNT_IF(account_is_locked_out) AS locked_accounts,
    COUNT_IF(bad_password_attempts >= 3) AS high_risk_accounts,
    CURRENT_DATE()
    
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_ancon_users

UNION ALL

SELECT
    'Account Activity',
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF('days', last_logon_date, CURRENT_DATE()) > 60) AS inactive_accounts,
    COUNT_IF(disabled) AS disabled_accounts,
    CURRENT_DATE()
    
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_ancon_users
;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_AV_H.name: VW_AV_HEALTH_BREAKDOWN
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_AV_H.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_av_health_breakdown

AS
SELECT
    f.opco_name,
    f.report_month,
    ROUND(f.av_installed_pct * 100, 2) AS coverage_pct,
    ROUND(f.old_signatures_pct * 100, 2) AS outdated_signatures_pct,
    ROUND(f.old_client_version_pct * 100, 2) AS outdated_clients_pct,
    ROUND(f.host_firewall_pct * 100, 2) AS firewall_disabled_pct,
    ROUND(f.av_health_score * 100, 2) AS overall_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.old_signatures_pct > 0.1 THEN 'Critical: Outdated Signatures'
        WHEN f.old_client_version_pct > 0.2 THEN 'High: Old Client Versions'
        WHEN f.host_firewall_pct > 0.05 THEN 'Medium: Firewall Disabled'
        ELSE 'Optimal' 
    END AS top_risk_factor,
    o.region,
    o.category
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_av_health f
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_av_opco o 
  ON f.opco_name = o.opco_name;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CROW.name: VW_CROWDSTRIKE_ENDPOINT_RISK
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CROW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_crowdstrike_endpoint_risk

AS
SELECT
    e.host_id,
    e.hostname,
    e.platform,
    e.os_product_name,
    e.sensor_version,
    v.support_date AS version_eol_date,
    v.days_until_eol,
    e.last_seen,
    e.is_active,
    DATEDIFF('days', e.last_seen, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_inactive,
    CASE
        WHEN v.days_until_eol < 0 THEN 'EOL Version'
        WHEN v.days_until_eol < 30 THEN 'Near EOL Version'
        WHEN e.os_product_name ILIKE '%server 2012%' THEN 'EOL OS'
        WHEN NOT e.is_active THEN 'Inactive >30 days'
        ELSE 'Low Risk'
    END AS risk_category,
    CASE
        WHEN risk_category != 'Low Risk' THEN 'Requires Action'
        ELSE 'Compliant'
    END AS remediation_status
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.crowdstrike_endpoints e
LEFT JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.crowdstrike_versions v
    ON e.sensor_version = v.version;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CYBE.name: VW_CYBELANGEL_RISK_SUMMARY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CYBE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_cybelangel_risk_summary

AS
SELECT
    threat_type AS exposure_type,
    severity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.incident_id) AS alert_count,
    SUM(t.volume_documents) AS total_documents_exposed,
    SUM(t.volume_emails) AS total_emails_exposed,
    SUM(t.volume_passwords) AS total_passwords_exposed,
    MIN(a.detection_date) AS first_detection,
    MAX(a.detection_date) AS last_detection,
    AVG(DATEDIFF('days', a.detection_date, CURRENT_DATE())) AS avg_days_outstanding,
    COUNT_IF(a.status NOT IN ('resolved', 'discarded')) AS unresolved_count
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_cybelangel_alerts a
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_cybelangel_threats t 
    ON a.alert_key = t.alert_key
GROUP BY threat_type, severity;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_DEFE.name: VW_DEFENDER_RANSOMWARE_TRACKING
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_DEFE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_defender_ransomware_tracking

AS
SELECT
    'RANSOMWARE' AS threat_category,
    COUNT(*) AS incident_count,
    MAX(threat_date) AS last_incident_date,
    DATEDIFF('days', last_incident_date, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_since_last_incident
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_defender_threats
WHERE threat_type ILIKE '%ransomware%';

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_SYMANTEC_RANSOMWARE_TIMELINE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_symantec_ransomware_timeline AS
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('day', t.threat_date) AS threat_day,
    COALESCE(e.symantec_opco, 'UNKNOWN') AS opco,  -- Usar desde dim_endpoints
    COUNT_IF(LOWER(t.threat_name) LIKE '%ransomware%') AS ransomware_count,
    MIN(DATEDIFF('day', t.threat_date, CURRENT_DATE())) AS days_since_last,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_symantec_threats t
LEFT JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_symantec_endpoints e
  ON t.computer_name = e.computer_name
WHERE t.threat_date >= DATEADD(month, -6, CURRENT_DATE())
GROUP BY threat_day, opco;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_QUAL.name: VW_QUALYS_SCAN_COVERAGE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_QUAL.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_qualys_scan_coverage

AS
SELECT
    'ALL_ASSETS' AS scope,
    COUNT(*) AS total_hosts,
    COUNT_IF(inscope) AS inscope_hosts,
    COUNT_IF(last_vm_auth_scan_date >= DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE())) AS scanned_30d,
    COUNT_IF(last_vm_auth_scan_date >= DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_DATE())) AS scanned_7d,
    ROUND(scanned_30d * 100.0 / inscope_hosts, 2) AS scan_coverage_pct,
    COUNT_IF(host_os ILIKE '%windows%') AS windows_hosts,
    COUNT_IF(host_os ILIKE '%linux%') AS linux_hosts,
    COUNT_IF(host_os ILIKE '%mac%') AS mac_hosts,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.qualys_host_data
WHERE inscope = TRUE;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLU.name: VW_SPLUNK_ALERT_TRENDS_FLEXIBLE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLU.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLUNK_ALERT_TRENDS_FLEXIBLE(
    ALERT_WEEK,
    COMPANY,
    PRIORITY,
    ALERT_COUNT,
    RESOLVED_COUNT,
    CLOSED_COUNT,
    FALSE_POSITIVE_COUNT,
    AVG_RESOLUTION_MIN,
    MIN_RESOLUTION_MIN,
    MAX_RESOLUTION_MIN,
    RESOLVED_WITHIN_4H,
    SLA_COMPLIANCE_PCT,
    SNAPSHOT_DATE
) 
AS
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('week', created_time) AS alert_week,
    company,
    priority,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count,
    COUNT_IF(state = 'Resolved') AS resolved_count,
    COUNT_IF(state = 'Closed') AS closed_count,
    COUNT_IF(close_code LIKE '%False Positive%') AS false_positive_count,
    AVG(CASE 
        WHEN resolved_time IS NOT NULL 
        THEN DATEDIFF('minute', created_time, resolved_time) 
    END) AS avg_resolution_min,
    MIN(CASE 
        WHEN resolved_time IS NOT NULL 
        THEN DATEDIFF('minute', created_time, resolved_time) 
    END) AS min_resolution_min,
    MAX(CASE 
        WHEN resolved_time IS NOT NULL 
        THEN DATEDIFF('minute', created_time, resolved_time) 
    END) AS max_resolution_min,
    COUNT_IF(
        resolved_time IS NOT NULL 
        AND DATEDIFF('minute', created_time, resolved_time) <= 240
    ) AS resolved_within_4h,
    ROUND(
        COUNT_IF(
            resolved_time IS NOT NULL 
            AND DATEDIFF('minute', created_time, resolved_time) <= 240
        ) * 100.0 / 
        NULLIF(COUNT_IF(resolved_time IS NOT NULL), 0), 
        2
    ) AS sla_compliance_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_splunk_alerts
-- Include all historical data
WHERE created_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY alert_week, company, priority;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CROW.name: VW_CROWDSTRIKE_USER_ACTIVITY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CROW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_crowdstrike_user_activity

AS
SELECT
    host_id,
    hostname,
    last_logged_in_user,
    last_user_login,
    DATEDIFF('days', last_user_login, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_since_login,
    CASE
        WHEN days_since_login > 90 THEN 'Stale Account'
        WHEN days_since_login > 60 THEN 'Inactive Warning'
        ELSE 'Active'
    END AS account_status,
    os_product_name
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.crowdstrike_endpoints;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CYBE.name: VW_CYBELANGEL_EXPOSURE_TREND
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CYBE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_cybelangel_exposure_trend

AS
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', a.detection_date) AS month,
    threat_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.incident_id) AS alert_count,
    SUM(t.volume_documents) AS documents_exposed,
    SUM(t.volume_emails) AS emails_exposed,
    SUM(t.volume_passwords) AS passwords_exposed,
    SUM(t.volume_domains) AS domains_exposed,
    LAG(alert_count) OVER (PARTITION BY threat_type ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_count,
    alert_count - prev_month_count AS monthly_change
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_cybelangel_alerts a
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_cybelangel_threats t 
    ON a.alert_key = t.alert_key
GROUP BY month, threat_type;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FARR.name: VW_FARRANS_OS_PROTECTION
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FARR.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_farrans_os_protection

AS
SELECT
    os,
    COUNT(*) AS total_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(CONTAINS(protection, 'Intercept X')) AS protected_count,
    COUNT_IF(NOT CONTAINS(protection, 'Intercept X')) AS unprotected_count,
    COUNT_IF(health_status = 'Healthy') AS healthy_count,
    COUNT_IF(health_status != 'Healthy') AS unhealthy_count,
    ROUND(protected_count * 100.0 / total_endpoints, 2) AS protection_pct,
    ROUND(healthy_count * 100.0 / total_endpoints, 2) AS health_pct,
    MAX(last_active) AS last_reported
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_farrans_endpoints e
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_farrans_health h 
    ON e.endpoint_name = h.endpoint_name
GROUP BY os;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_SYMANTEC_EDR_COVERAGE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_symantec_edr_coverage AS
SELECT
    symantec_opco AS opco,
    COUNT_IF(device_security_status = 'Protected' AND 
             last_update_time >= DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP())) AS protected_assets,
    COUNT(*) AS total_assets,
    ROUND(protected_assets * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_assets, 0), 2) AS coverage_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_symantec_endpoints
GROUP BY symantec_opco;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_THREATINTEL_ASSET_PERFORMANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_threatintel_asset_performance AS
SELECT
    asset_type,
    COUNT_IF(takedown_successful) AS successful,
    COUNT_IF(NOT takedown_successful) AS failed,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    ROUND(successful * 100.0 / NULLIF(total, 0), 2) AS success_rate,
    AVG(CASE WHEN takedown_successful THEN DATEDIFF(hour, event_date, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) END) AS avg_resolution_hours_success,
    AVG(CASE WHEN NOT takedown_successful THEN DATEDIFF(hour, event_date, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()) END) AS avg_resolution_hours_failed,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_threat_intel_events
GROUP BY asset_type;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OBJE.name: VW_OBJECT_COUNTS_DEV
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OBJE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OBJECT_COUNTS_DEV AS
SELECT 
    environment,
    table_type,
    COUNT(*) AS object_count
FROM SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OBJECT_INVENTORY_DEV
GROUP BY environment, table_type;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FARR.name: VW_FARRANS_COMPLIANCE_STATUS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FARR.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_farrans_compliance_status

AS
SELECT
    e.endpoint_name,
    e.os,
    e.protection,
    h.health_status,
    h.last_active,
    DATEDIFF('day', h.last_active, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_since_last_activity,
    CASE
        WHEN CONTAINS(e.protection, 'Intercept X') AND h.health_status = 'Healthy' 
            THEN 'Compliant'
        WHEN NOT CONTAINS(e.protection, 'Intercept X') 
            THEN 'Non-compliant: Protection missing'
        WHEN h.health_status != 'Healthy' 
            THEN 'Non-compliant: Unhealthy agent'
        ELSE 'Compliant'
    END AS compliance_status,
    CASE
        WHEN compliance_status != 'Compliant' THEN 'Requires attention'
        WHEN days_since_last_activity > 30 THEN 'Requires attention: Inactive'
        ELSE 'Compliant'
    END AS action_required
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_farrans_endpoints e
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_farrans_health h 
    ON e.endpoint_name = h.endpoint_name;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_TRENDMICRO_ALERTS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_trendmicro_alerts AS
SELECT
    name AS endpoint_name,
    group_path AS opco,
    platform,
    status,
    last_seen_date,
    version,
    security_update_status,
    software_update_status,
    DATEDIFF(day, last_seen_date, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_since_last_seen,
    DATEDIFF(day, version_release_date, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_since_version,
    CASE
        WHEN status != 'Managed (Online)' THEN 'OFFLINE_ENDPOINT'
        WHEN security_update_status = 'Out-of-Date' THEN 'OUTDATED_SECURITY'
        WHEN software_update_status = 'Out-of-Date' THEN 'OUTDATED_SOFTWARE'
        WHEN days_since_last_seen > 7 THEN 'STALE_ENDPOINT'
        ELSE 'COMPLIANT'
    END AS alert_type,
    CASE
        WHEN status != 'Managed (Online)' THEN 'Endpoint is offline'
        WHEN security_update_status = 'Out-of-Date' THEN 'Security updates out-of-date'
        WHEN software_update_status = 'Out-of-Date' THEN 'Software version out-of-date'
        WHEN days_since_last_seen > 7 THEN 'No communication for >7 days'
        ELSE 'No issues detected'
    END AS alert_description,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_trendmicro_endpoints
WHERE alert_type != 'COMPLIANT';

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_HOST.name: VW_HOSTS_SECURITY_RISKS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_HOST.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_hosts_security_risks

AS
SELECT
    a.asset_id,
    a.ip,
    a.os,
    a.bu,
    DATEDIFF('day', a.last_activity, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_inactive,
    DATEDIFF('day', MAX(s.scan_date), CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_since_last_scan,
    CASE
        WHEN days_inactive > 90 THEN 'CRITICAL: Inactive >90 days'
        WHEN days_inactive > 60 THEN 'HIGH: Inactive 61-90 days'
        WHEN days_since_last_scan > 30 THEN 'HIGH: No scan in 30+ days'
        WHEN a.os IS NULL OR a.os = '' THEN 'MEDIUM: OS not identified'
        ELSE 'LOW: Compliant'
    END AS risk_level,
    CASE
        WHEN risk_level LIKE 'CRITICAL%' OR risk_level LIKE 'HIGH%' THEN 'Requires immediate action'
        WHEN risk_level LIKE 'MEDIUM%' THEN 'Needs attention'
        ELSE 'Compliant'
    END AS action_required
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_host_assets a
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT asset_id, MAX(scan_date) AS scan_date
    FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_scan_events
    GROUP BY asset_id
) s ON a.asset_id = s.asset_id
GROUP BY a.asset_id, a.ip, a.os, a.bu, a.last_activity, s.scan_date;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_ZEROFOX_THREAT_ACTORS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_zerofox_threat_actors AS
SELECT
    perpetrator_display_name AS threat_actor,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT z.opco) AS affected_opcos,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.network_name) AS platforms_used,
    MIN(a.created_at) AS first_observed,
    MAX(a.created_at) AS last_observed,
    COUNT_IF(a.content_removed) AS removed_count,
    COUNT_IF(a.domain_live) AS live_count,
    COUNT_IF(a.escalated) AS escalated_count,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_zerofox_alerts a
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_zerofox_assets z 
    ON a.asset_id = z.asset_id
WHERE perpetrator_display_name IS NOT NULL
    AND a.created_at >= DATEADD(month, -6, CURRENT_DATE())
GROUP BY threat_actor;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CISC.name: VW_CISCO_AMP_ENDPOINT_HEALTH
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CISC.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_cisco_amp_endpoint_health

AS
SELECT
    Connector_GUID,
    Hostname,
    Last_Seen,
    Connector_Version,
    Operating_System,
    Is_Active,
    DATEDIFF('days', Last_Seen, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_inactive,
    CASE
        WHEN NOT Is_Active THEN 'Inactive >30 days'
        WHEN Connector_VERSION < '8.0.0' THEN 'Outdated Version'
        WHEN Operating_System LIKE '%Server 2012%' THEN 'EOL OS'
        ELSE 'Healthy'
    END AS health_status,
    CASE
        WHEN health_status != 'Healthy' THEN 'Requires Attention'
        ELSE 'Compliant'
    END AS action_status
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.CISCO_AMP_data;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CYBE.name: VW_CYBELANGEL_CRITICAL_EXPOSURES
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CYBE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_cybelangel_critical_exposures

AS
SELECT
    a.incident_id,
    a.detection_date,
    a.hostname,
    a.source,
    a.severity,
    a.threat,
    t.threat_type,
    t.volume_documents,
    t.volume_emails,
    t.volume_passwords,
    DATEDIFF('days', a.detection_date, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_outstanding,
    CASE
        WHEN days_outstanding > 30 THEN 'Critical: Overdue'
        WHEN days_outstanding > 15 THEN 'High: Aging'
        ELSE 'Medium: Needs Attention'
    END AS remediation_urgency,
    t.detected_data_sample,
    a.status,
    a.status_checking_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_cybelangel_alerts a
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_cybelangel_threats t 
    ON a.alert_key = t.alert_key
WHERE a.severity IN ('ReportSeverity.MAJOR', 'ReportSeverity.CRITICAL')
    AND a.status NOT IN ('resolved', 'discarded')
    AND a.detection_date >= DATEADD('month', -3, CURRENT_DATE());

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FIXE.name: VW_FIXEDVULN_RECURRING_ISSUES
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FIXE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_fixedvuln_recurring_issues

AS
SELECT
    v.qid,
    v.title,
    v.type,
    v.severity,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.asset_id) AS affected_assets,
    AVG(e.times_reopened) AS avg_reopened_count,
    MAX(e.times_reopened) AS max_reopened_count,
    AVG(e.remediation_days) AS avg_remediation_days,
    LISTAGG(DISTINCT e.os, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.os) AS affected_os,
    MAX(e.last_fixed) AS most_recent_fix
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_remediation_events e
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_fixed_vulnerabilities v 
    ON e.qid = v.qid
WHERE e.times_reopened > 0
GROUP BY v.qid, v.title, v.type, v.severity
HAVING avg_reopened_count > 1;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FIXE.name: VW_FIXEDVULN_TOP_ASSETS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FIXE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_fixedvuln_top_assets

AS
SELECT
    e.asset_id,
    e.os,
    COUNT(*) AS total_vulnerabilities,
    COUNT_IF(v.severity >= 4) AS critical_high_count,
    COUNT_IF(e.times_reopened > 0) AS reopened_count,
    MAX(e.remediation_days) AS max_remediation_days,
    AVG(e.remediation_days) AS avg_remediation_days,
    MAX(e.last_fixed) AS last_fixed_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_remediation_events e
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_fixed_vulnerabilities v 
    ON e.qid = v.qid
GROUP BY e.asset_id, e.os
ORDER BY total_vulnerabilities DESC
LIMIT 50;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_HOST.name: VW_HOSTS_CLOUD_ASSETS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_HOST.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_hosts_cloud_assets

AS
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.cloud_provider, 'ON-PREMISE') AS cloud_provider,
    COALESCE(a.cloud_service, 'NON-CLOUD') AS cloud_service,
    a.bu,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.asset_id) AS asset_count,
    COUNT_IF(s.scan_date >= DATEADD('day', -30, CURRENT_DATE())) AS scanned_last_30d,
    ROUND(scanned_last_30d * 100.0 / asset_count, 2) AS scan_coverage_pct,
    AVG(s.scan_duration_seconds) AS avg_scan_duration,
    MIN(a.first_found_date) AS oldest_asset,
    MAX(a.last_activity) AS most_recent_activity
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_host_assets a
LEFT JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_scan_events s 
    ON a.asset_id = s.asset_id
GROUP BY cloud_provider, cloud_service, a.bu;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_LEVI.name: VW_LEVIAT_SECURITY_ALERTS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_LEVI.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_leviat_security_alerts

AS
SELECT 
    a.alert_type,
    u.opco AS business_unit,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.username) AS affected_users,
    MAX(CASE 
            WHEN alert_type = 'PASSWORD_EXPIRED' THEN 'High'
            WHEN alert_type = 'LOCKED_ACCOUNT' THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low' 
        END) AS severity,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_leviat_security_alerts a
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_leviat_users u
    ON a.username = u.username
GROUP BY alert_type, business_unit;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OBJE.name: VW_OBJECT_INVENTORY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OBJE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OBJECT_INVENTORY AS
SELECT 
    table_catalog     AS environment,
    table_schema      AS schema_name,
    table_name,
    table_type,
    created,
    last_altered

WHERE 
    table_schema = 'SECURITY_ANALYTICS'
    AND table_catalog IN (
        'DEV_LANDING', 'DEV_TRANSFORMATION', 'DEV_REPORTING',

    );

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OBJE.name: VW_OBJECT_INVENTORY_DEV
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OBJE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OBJECT_INVENTORY_DEV AS
SELECT 
    table_catalog     AS environment,
    table_schema      AS schema_name,

    table_type,

    table_schema,
    table_name,

    last_altered,

        WHEN table_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1

    END

WHERE table_schema = 'SECURITY_ANALYTICS'

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    table_catalog,
    table_schema,
    table_name,
    table_type,
    created,
    last_altered,
    CASE 
        WHEN table_type = 'VIEW' THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END
FROM DEV_REPORTING.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES
WHERE table_schema = 'SECURITY_ANALYTICS';

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OS_D.name: VW_OS_DISTRIBUTION
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_OS_D.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_os_distribution

AS
SELECT
    SPLIT_PART(operating_system, ' ', 1) AS os_family,
    operating_system,
    COUNT(*) AS device_count,
    MIN(last_scanned) AS oldest_scan,
    MAX(last_scanned) AS newest_scan,
    CASE 
        WHEN os_family ILIKE '%server 2012%' THEN 'EOL OS'
        WHEN os_family ILIKE '%windows 7%' THEN 'EOL OS'
        WHEN os_family ILIKE '%windows 8%' THEN 'EOL OS'
        WHEN os_family ILIKE '%sierra%' THEN 'EOL OS'
        ELSE 'Supported'
    END AS support_status
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_hardware_inventory
GROUP BY os_family, operating_system, support_status;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_MCAF.name: VW_MCAFEE_EDR_COVERAGE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_MCAF.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_mcafee_edr_coverage

AS
SELECT
    'ALL_ENDPOINTS' AS scope,
    COUNT(*) AS total_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(compliance_status = 'Compliant') AS compliant_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(last_communication >= DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_DATE())) AS active_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(esp_patch_version >= 5) AS updated_patch_version,
    ROUND(compliant_endpoints * 100.0 / total_endpoints, 2) AS compliance_pct,
    ROUND(active_endpoints * 100.0 / total_endpoints, 2) AS active_coverage_pct,
    ROUND(updated_patch_version * 100.0 / total_endpoints, 2) AS patch_compliance_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_mcafee_endpoints;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLU.name: VW_SPLUNK_ALERT_TRENDS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLU.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLUNK_ALERT_TRENDS AS
SELECT
    alert_week,
    company,
    priority,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count,
    COUNT_IF(state IN ('Closed', 'Resolved')) AS resolved_count,
    COUNT_IF(close_code LIKE '%False Positive%' OR close_code LIKE '%Anomalous Safe%') AS successful_resolutions,
    AVG(resolution_minutes) AS avg_resolution_min,
    COUNT_IF(resolution_minutes <= 240) AS resolved_within_4h,
    ROUND(COUNT_IF(resolution_minutes <= 240) * 100.0 / 
          NULLIF(COUNT_IF(state IN ('Closed', 'Resolved')), 0), 2) AS sla_compliance_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_splunk_alerts_weekly
WHERE created_time >= DATEADD('month', -24, CURRENT_DATE())
GROUP BY alert_week, company, priority;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLU.name: VW_SPLUNK_ANALYSIS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLU.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLUNK_ANALYSIS AS

-- Basic version that avoids expensive operations
SELECT
    a.SOURCE_NAME,
    a.NUMBER AS ALERT_ID,  
    a.CREATED,
    a.STATE,
    a.PRIORITY,
    a.COMPANY,
    a.SHORT_DESCRIPTION,
    a.RESOLVED,
    a.RESOLVED_BY,
    a.CLOSE_CODE,
    a.CLOSE_NOTES,
    
    -- Simple categorization without complex parsing
    CASE 
        WHEN CONTAINS(a.PRIORITY, '1') OR CONTAINS(a.PRIORITY, 'High') THEN 'High'
        WHEN CONTAINS(a.PRIORITY, '2') OR CONTAINS(a.PRIORITY, 'Medium') THEN 'Medium'
        WHEN CONTAINS(a.PRIORITY, '3') OR CONTAINS(a.PRIORITY, 'Low') THEN 'Low'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS PRIORITY_CATEGORY,
    
    -- Simplified alert type categorization
    CASE
        WHEN CONTAINS(a.SHORT_DESCRIPTION, 'Threat') THEN 'Security Threat'
        WHEN CONTAINS(a.SHORT_DESCRIPTION, 'Endpoint') THEN 'Endpoint Issue'
        WHEN CONTAINS(a.SHORT_DESCRIPTION, 'Audit') THEN 'Audit Alert'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS ALERT_CATEGORY
FROM 
    DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.SPLUNK_ALERTS a
;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_TRENDMICRO_COMPLIANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_trendmicro_compliance AS
SELECT
    group_path AS opco,
    platform,
    COUNT_IF(send_policy_successful = 'Yes') AS policy_compliant,
    COUNT_IF(maintenance_mode = 'No') AS active_mode,
    COUNT_IF(status = 'Managed (Online)') AS online_status,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    ROUND(policy_compliant * 100.0 / NULLIF(endpoint_count, 0), 2) AS policy_compliance_rate,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_trendmicro_endpoints
GROUP BY group_path, platform;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_ZEROFOX_RESPONSE_PERFORMANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_zerofox_response_performance AS
SELECT
    z.opco,
    a.alert_type,
    AVG(DATEDIFF(hour, a.created_at, a.last_modified)) AS avg_response_hours,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY DATEDIFF(hour, a.created_at, a.last_modified)) AS p90_response_hours,
    COUNT_IF(a.content_removed) AS successful_resolutions,
    COUNT_IF(a.status = 'closed') AS closed_alerts,
    COUNT_IF(a.status = 'open' AND DATEDIFF(day, a.created_at, CURRENT_DATE()) > 7) AS stale_alerts,
    ROUND(successful_resolutions * 100.0 / NULLIF(closed_alerts, 0), 2) AS success_rate,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_zerofox_alerts a
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_zerofox_assets z 
    ON a.asset_id = z.asset_id
GROUP BY z.opco, a.alert_type;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLU.name: VW_SPLUNK_ALERT_TRENDS_SIMPLE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLU.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLUNK_ALERT_TRENDS_SIMPLE AS
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('week', f.created_time) AS alert_week,
    f.company,
    f.priority,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_splunk_alerts f
WHERE f.created_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', f.created_time), f.company, f.priority;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_AGEN.name: VW_AGENT_COVERAGE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_AGEN.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_agent_coverage

AS
SELECT
    organisation,
    COUNT_IF(client_version IS NOT NULL) AS protected_devices,
    COUNT_IF(client_version IS NULL) AS unprotected_devices,
    ROUND(protected_devices * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS coverage_percentage,
    client_configuration AS agent_type,
    MAX(msi_version) AS latest_version
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_hardware_inventory
GROUP BY organisation, client_configuration;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_AV_C.name: VW_AV_COMPLIANCE_SETTINGS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_AV_C.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_av_compliance_settings

AS
SELECT
    'EDR_COVERAGE_TARGET' AS parameter_name,
    98 AS parameter_value,
    'Minimum required EDR coverage percentage' AS description
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'OUTDATED_SIGNATURE_THRESHOLD',
    10,
    'Maximum allowed % of endpoints with outdated signatures'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'FIREWALL_DISABLED_THRESHOLD',
    5,
    'Maximum allowed % of endpoints with disabled firewall'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'OLD_CLIENT_VERSION_THRESHOLD',

    'Maximum allowed % of endpoints with outdated client versions';

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_THREATINTEL_SOURCE_ANALYSIS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_threatintel_source_analysis AS
SELECT
    source,
    asset_type,
    COUNT(*) AS event_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT opco) AS affected_opcos,
    MIN(event_date) AS first_detected,
    MAX(event_date) AS last_detected,
    COUNT_IF(NOT takedown_successful) AS failed_takedowns,
    ROUND(failed_takedowns * 100.0 / NULLIF(event_count, 0), 2) AS failure_rate,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_threat_intel_events
GROUP BY source, asset_type;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FIXE.name: VW_FIXEDVULN_REMEDIATION_PERFORMANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FIXE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_fixedvuln_remediation_performance

AS
SELECT
    v.severity,
    COUNT(*) AS vulnerabilities_fixed,
    AVG(e.remediation_days) AS avg_remediation_days,
    MEDIAN(e.remediation_days) AS median_remediation_days,
    MAX(e.remediation_days) AS max_remediation_days,
    AVG(e.times_reopened) AS avg_reopened_count,
    COUNT_IF(e.remediation_days <= 7) AS fixed_within_7d,
    COUNT_IF(e.remediation_days > 7 AND e.remediation_days <= 30) AS fixed_8_30d,
    COUNT_IF(e.remediation_days > 30) AS fixed_over_30d,
    ROUND(fixed_within_7d * 100.0 / vulnerabilities_fixed, 2) AS sla_7d_compliance
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_remediation_events e
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_fixed_vulnerabilities v 
    ON e.qid = v.qid
GROUP BY v.severity;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_ZEROFOX_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_zerofox_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    'ASSETS' AS table_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_records,
    COUNT_IF(asset_id IS NULL) AS null_asset_id,
    COUNT_IF(domains IS NULL) AS null_domains,
    COUNT_IF(status IS NULL) AS null_status,
    ROUND(null_asset_id * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_records, 0), 2) AS pct_null_asset_id,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_zerofox_assets
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'ALERTS',
    COUNT(*),
    COUNT_IF(asset_id IS NULL),
    COUNT_IF(created_at IS NULL),
    COUNT_IF(severity IS NULL),
    ROUND(COUNT_IF(asset_id IS NULL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2),
    CURRENT_DATE()
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_zerofox_alerts;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_MCAF.name: VW_MCAFEE_AGENT_HEALTH
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_MCAF.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_mcafee_agent_health

AS
SELECT
    SPLIT_PART(agent_version, '.', 1) AS major_version,
    compliance_status,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    AVG(DATEDIFF(day, last_communication, CURRENT_DATE())) AS avg_days_inactive,
    MIN(esp_patch_version) AS min_patch_version,
    MAX(esp_patch_version) AS max_patch_version,
    COUNT_IF(last_communication < DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_DATE())) AS stale_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(esp_patch_version < 5) AS outdated_patches,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_mcafee_endpoints
GROUP BY major_version, compliance_status;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_MCAF.name: VW_MCAFEE_PATCH_COMPLIANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_MCAF.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_mcafee_patch_compliance

AS
SELECT
    esp_patch_version,
    compliance_status,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS percent_of_total,
    MIN(last_communication) AS oldest_communication,
    MAX(last_communication) AS newest_communication,
    COUNT_IF(last_communication < DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_DATE())) AS inactive_endpoints,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_mcafee_endpoints
GROUP BY esp_patch_version, compliance_status;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SOPH.name: VW_SOPHOS_USER_ACTIVITY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SOPH.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_sophos_user_activity

AS
SELECT
    last_user,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    COUNT_IF(health_status = 'Healthy') AS healthy_count,
    COUNT_IF(protection = 'Protected') AS protected_count,
    MIN(last_active) AS oldest_activity,
    MAX(last_active) AS newest_activity,
    COUNT_IF(last_active >= DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_DATE())) AS active_7d,
    COUNT_IF(last_active < DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE())) AS inactive_30d,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_sophos_endpoints
GROUP BY last_user;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLU.name: VW_SPLUNK_ALERT_RESPONSE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLU.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_splunk_alert_response

AS
SELECT
    company,
    priority,
    COUNT(*) AS total_alerts,
    COUNT_IF(state = 'Closed') AS resolved_alerts,
    COUNT_IF(state = 'Open') AS open_alerts,
    COUNT_IF(close_code = 'Successful') AS successful_resolutions,
    AVG(DATEDIFF('minute', created_time, resolved_time)) AS avg_resolution_minutes,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY DATEDIFF('minute', created_time, resolved_time)) AS p90_resolution_minutes,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF('minute', created_time, resolved_time) <= 240) AS resolved_within_4h,
    ROUND(resolved_within_4h * 100.0 / resolved_alerts, 2) AS sla_compliance_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_splunk_alerts
WHERE resolved_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY company, priority;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SENT.name: VW_SENTINEL_SECURITY_STATUS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SENT.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_sentinel_security_status

AS
SELECT
    os_version,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    COUNT_IF(update_status) AS compliant_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(NOT update_status) AS non_compliant_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(last_active < DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE())) AS inactive_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(device_type = 'Server') AS servers,
    COUNT_IF(device_type = 'Workstation') AS workstations,
    ROUND(compliant_endpoints * 100.0 / endpoint_count, 2) AS compliance_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_sentinel_endpoints
GROUP BY os_version;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLU.name: VW_SPLUNK_RESOLUTION_EFFECTIVENESS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLU.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_splunk_resolution_effectiveness

AS
SELECT
    close_code,
    company,
    COUNT(*) AS resolution_count,
    AVG(DATEDIFF('minute', created_time, resolved_time)) AS avg_resolution_min,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY DATEDIFF('minute', created_time, resolved_time)) AS p90_resolution_min,
    COUNT_IF(priority = 1) AS critical_count,
    COUNT_IF(priority = 2) AS high_count,
    COUNT_IF(priority = 3) AS medium_count,
    COUNT_IF(priority = 4) AS low_count,
    ROUND(COUNT_IF(close_code = 'Successful') * 100.0 / resolution_count, 2) AS success_rate_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_splunk_alerts
WHERE resolved_time IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY close_code, company;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_AV_E.name: VW_AV_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_AV_E.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_av_executive_summary

AS
SELECT
    report_month,
    ROUND(AVG(av_installed_pct) * 100, 2) AS global_coverage_pct,
    COUNT_IF(av_installed_pct >= 0.98) AS compliant_opcos,
    COUNT_IF(av_installed_pct < 0.98) AS non_compliant_opcos,
    ROUND(AVG(av_health_score) * 100, 2) AS global_health_score,
    ROUND(AVG(old_signatures_pct) * 100, 2) AS global_outdated_signatures,
    ROUND(AVG(old_client_version_pct) * 100, 2) AS global_outdated_clients
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_av_health
GROUP BY report_month;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CISC.name: VW_CISCO_AMP_COMPLIANCE_SETTINGS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CISC.definition:

    PARAMETER_NAME,
    PARAMETER_VALUE,
    DESCRIPTION
) 
AS
