DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CROW.name: VW_CROWDSTRIKE_CLOUD_COVERAGE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CROW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_crowdstrike_cloud_coverage

AS
SELECT
    COALESCE(cloud_provider, 'On-Prem') AS environment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT host_id) AS total_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(is_active) AS active_endpoints,
    ROUND(active_endpoints * 100.0 / total_endpoints, 2) AS coverage_pct,
    COUNT_IF(v.days_until_eol < 0) AS eol_versions,
    ROUND(eol_versions * 100.0 / total_endpoints, 2) AS eol_pct
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.crowdstrike_endpoints e
LEFT JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.crowdstrike_versions v
    ON e.sensor_version = v.version
GROUP BY environment;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_DEFE.name: VW_DEFENDER_DEVICE_COMPLIANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_DEFE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_defender_device_compliance

AS
SELECT
    device_id,
    device_name,
    operating_system,
    compliance,
    device_state,
    last_status_update,
    DATEDIFF('days', last_status_update, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_since_last_check,
    CASE
        WHEN compliance != 'Compliant' THEN 'Non-compliant device'
        WHEN days_since_last_check > 7 THEN 'Inactive >7 days'
        ELSE 'Compliant'
    END AS compliance_status
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_defender_endpoints;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FIXE.name: VW_FIXEDVULN_TYPE_ANALYSIS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FIXE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_fixedvuln_type_analysis

AS
SELECT
    v.type,
    v.severity,
    COUNT(*) AS vulnerability_count,
    AVG(e.remediation_days) AS avg_remediation_days,
    AVG(e.times_reopened) AS avg_reopened_count,
    COUNT_IF(e.remediation_days <= CASE 
        WHEN v.severity >= 4 THEN 7 
        WHEN v.severity = 3 THEN 14 
        ELSE 30 
    END) AS within_sla,
    ROUND(within_sla * 100.0 / vulnerability_count, 2) AS sla_compliance_pct,
    MAX(e.last_fixed) AS last_fixed_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_remediation_events e
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_fixed_vulnerabilities v 
    ON e.qid = v.qid
GROUP BY v.type, v.severity;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_TRELLIX_EDR_COVERAGE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_trellix_edr_coverage AS
SELECT
    domain_name AS opco,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF(day, last_communication, CURRENT_DATE()) <= 1) AS active_endpoints,
    COUNT(*) AS total_endpoints,
    ROUND(active_endpoints * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_endpoints, 0), 2) AS coverage_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_trellix_endpoints
GROUP BY domain_name;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_HOST.name: VW_HOSTS_BU_COMPLIANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_HOST.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_hosts_bu_compliance

AS
WITH compliance_data AS (
    SELECT
        a.bu,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.asset_id) AS total_assets,
        COUNT_IF(a.os IS NOT NULL AND a.os != '') AS os_identified,
        COUNT_IF(s.scan_date >= DATEADD('day', -30, CURRENT_DATE())) AS scanned_30d,
        COUNT_IF(a.last_activity >= DATEADD('day', -90, CURRENT_DATE())) AS active_90d,
        COUNT_IF(risk.risk_level LIKE 'CRITICAL%' OR risk.risk_level LIKE 'HIGH%') AS high_risk_assets
    FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_host_assets a
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT asset_id, MAX(scan_date) AS scan_date
        FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_scan_events
        GROUP BY asset_id
    ) s ON a.asset_id = s.asset_id
    LEFT JOIN DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_hosts_security_risks risk 
        ON a.asset_id = risk.asset_id
    GROUP BY a.bu
)
SELECT
    bu,
    total_assets,
    ROUND(os_identified * 100.0 / total_assets, 2) AS os_completeness_pct,
    ROUND(scanned_30d * 100.0 / total_assets, 2) AS scan_coverage_pct,
    ROUND(active_90d * 100.0 / total_assets, 2) AS active_assets_pct,
    ROUND(high_risk_assets * 100.0 / total_assets, 2) AS high_risk_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN os_completeness_pct >= 98 
            AND scan_coverage_pct >= 95 
            AND active_assets_pct >= 95 
            AND high_risk_pct <= 5 
        THEN 'Compliant'
        ELSE 'Non-compliant'
    END AS compliance_status
FROM compliance_data;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CROW.name: VW_CROWDSTRIKE_VERSION_COMPLIANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CROW.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_crowdstrike_version_compliance

AS
SELECT
    v.version,
    v.support_date,
    v.days_until_eol,
    COUNT(e.host_id) AS endpoint_count,
    MIN(e.last_seen) AS oldest_last_seen,
    MAX(e.last_seen) AS newest_last_seen,
    CASE
        WHEN days_until_eol >= 0 THEN 'Supported'
        WHEN days_until_eol BETWEEN -180 AND 0 THEN 'Recently EOL'
        ELSE 'Long EOL'
    END AS support_status,
    CASE
        WHEN days_until_eol >= 90 THEN 'Compliant'
        WHEN days_until_eol >= 0 THEN 'Warning'
        ELSE 'Non-Compliant'
    END AS compliance_status
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.crowdstrike_versions v
LEFT JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.crowdstrike_endpoints e
    ON v.version = e.sensor_version
GROUP BY v.version, v.support_date, v.days_until_eol;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CYBE.name: VW_CYBELANGEL_SOURCE_ANALYSIS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CYBE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_cybelangel_source_analysis

AS
SELECT
    source,
    COUNT(DISTINCT incident_id) AS alert_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN severity IN ('ReportSeverity.MAJOR', 'ReportSeverity.CRITICAL') 
                   THEN incident_id END) AS critical_alerts,
    SUM(t.volume_documents) AS total_documents,
    SUM(t.volume_emails) AS total_emails,
    SUM(t.volume_passwords) AS total_passwords,
    ROUND(critical_alerts * 100.0 / alert_count, 2) AS critical_pct
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_cybelangel_alerts a
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_cybelangel_threats t 
    ON a.alert_key = t.alert_key
GROUP BY source;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_THREATINTEL_DATA_QUALITY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_threatintel_data_quality AS
SELECT 
    'EVENTS' AS table_name,
    COUNT(*) AS total_records,
    COUNT_IF(event_date IS NULL) AS null_dates,
    COUNT_IF(takedown_successful IS NULL) AS null_takedown,
    ROUND(null_dates * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_records, 0), 2) AS pct_null_dates,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_threat_intel_events
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'SUMMARY',
    COUNT(*),
    COUNT_IF(month_year IS NULL),
    COUNT_IF(total_events IS NULL),
    ROUND(COUNT_IF(month_year IS NULL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2),
    CURRENT_DATE()
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_threat_intel_summary;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_TRELLIX_SECURITY_ALERTS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_trellix_security_alerts AS
SELECT
    system_name,
    domain_name AS opco,
    os_type,
    last_communication,
    amcore_date,
    DATEDIFF(day, last_communication, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_since_comm,
    DATEDIFF(day, amcore_date, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_since_amcore,
    CASE
        WHEN days_since_comm > 7 THEN 'STALE_ENDPOINT'
        WHEN days_since_amcore > 30 THEN 'OUTDATED_AMCORE'
        ELSE 'COMPLIANT'
    END AS alert_type,
    CASE
        WHEN days_since_comm > 7 THEN 'Endpoint not communicating >7 days'
        WHEN days_since_amcore > 30 THEN 'AMCore engine outdated >30 days'
        ELSE 'No issues detected'
    END AS alert_description,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_trellix_endpoints
WHERE days_since_comm > 7 OR days_since_amcore > 30;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_LEVI.name: VW_LEVIAT_PASSWORD_COMPLIANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_LEVI.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_leviat_password_compliance

AS
SELECT
    opco AS business_unit,
    COUNT_IF(password_never_expires) AS never_expire_passwords,
    COUNT_IF(password_age_days <= 90) AS compliant_passwords,
    ROUND(compliant_passwords * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS compliance_pct,
    AVG(password_age_days) AS avg_password_age,
    MAX(password_age_days) AS max_password_age,
    COUNT_IF(password_age_days > 180) AS critical_expired_passwords
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_leviat_users
GROUP BY business_unit;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_MCAF.name: VW_MCAFEE_SECURITY_ALERTS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_MCAF.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_mcafee_security_alerts

AS
SELECT
    alert_type,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT system_name) AS affected_endpoints,
    MAX(CASE 
            WHEN alert_type = 'NON_COMPLIANT' THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN alert_type = 'OUTDATED_PATCH' THEN 'High'
            WHEN alert_type = 'AGENT_OUTDATED' THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low' 
        END) AS severity,
    AVG(DATEDIFF(day, last_communication, CURRENT_DATE())) AS avg_days_inactive,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_mcafee_security_alerts
GROUP BY alert_type;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_THREATINTEL_MONTHLY_TRENDS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_threatintel_monthly_trends AS
WITH monthly_events AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', event_date) AS event_month,
        opco,
        source,
        COUNT(event_key) AS verified_events
    FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_threat_intel_events
    GROUP BY event_month, opco, source
)
SELECT
    s.month_year,
    s.opco,
    s.source,
    s.total_events,
    COALESCE(m.verified_events, 0) AS verified_events,
    ROUND(COALESCE(m.verified_events, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(s.total_events, 0), 2) AS verification_rate,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_threat_intel_summary s
LEFT JOIN monthly_events m
    ON s.month_year = m.event_month
    AND s.opco = m.opco
    AND s.source = m.source;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.name: VW_GOLD_ZEROFOX_DOMAIN_PROTECTION
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_GOLD.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_gold_zerofox_domain_protection AS
SELECT
    z.opco,
    z.domains AS protected_domain,
    COUNT(a.alert_id) AS total_alerts,
    COUNT_IF(a.content_removed) AS removed_alerts,
    COUNT_IF(a.domain_live) AS live_alerts,
    COUNT_IF(a.status = 'open') AS open_alerts,
    ROUND(removed_alerts * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_alerts, 0), 2) AS removal_rate,
    MIN(a.created_at) AS first_alert,
    MAX(a.created_at) AS last_alert,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_zerofox_assets z
LEFT JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_zerofox_alerts a 
    ON z.asset_id = a.asset_id
    AND a.network_name = 'domains'
WHERE z.status = 'protected'
GROUP BY z.opco, z.domains;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SOPH.name: VW_SOPHOS_EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SOPH.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_sophos_executive_summary

AS
SELECT
    'ENDPOINT_SECURITY' AS metric_category,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_sophos_endpoints) AS total_endpoints,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(health_status = 'Healthy') FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_sophos_endpoints) AS healthy_endpoints,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(protection = 'Protected') FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_sophos_endpoints) AS protected_endpoints,
    (SELECT COUNT_IF(last_active >= DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_DATE())) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_sophos_endpoints) AS active_7d,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_sophos_security_alerts) AS active_alerts,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ZSCA.name: VW_ZSCALER_DEPLOYMENT_COVERAGE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ZSCA.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_zscaler_deployment_coverage

AS
WITH agent_coverage AS (
    SELECT
        device_hostname,
        CASE WHEN last_connected >= DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_DATE()) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS active_agent,
        -- Placeholder for SOX classification - to be replaced with actual SOX mapping logic
        CASE WHEN device_type ILIKE '%server%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_sox_system
    FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_zscaler_endpoints
)
SELECT
    'ALL_SYSTEMS' AS coverage_scope,
    COUNT(device_hostname) AS total_devices,
    SUM(active_agent) AS covered_devices,
    ROUND(covered_devices * 100.0 / total_devices, 2) AS coverage_pct,
    ROUND((total_devices - covered_devices) * 100.0 / total_devices, 2) AS gap_pct
FROM agent_coverage
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'SOX_SYSTEMS' AS coverage_scope,
    COUNT(device_hostname) AS total_devices,
    SUM(active_agent) AS covered_devices,
    ROUND(covered_devices * 100.0 / total_devices, 2) AS coverage_pct,
    ROUND((total_devices - covered_devices) * 100.0 / total_devices, 2) AS gap_pct
FROM agent_coverage
WHERE is_sox_system = 1;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FARR.name: VW_FARRANS_PROTECTION_COVERAGE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_FARR.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_farrans_protection_coverage

AS
SELECT
    'ALL_ENDPOINTS' AS coverage_scope,
    COUNT(*) AS total_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(CONTAINS(protection, 'Intercept X')) AS protected_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(NOT CONTAINS(protection, 'Intercept X')) AS unprotected_endpoints,
    ROUND((protected_endpoints * 100.0) / total_endpoints, 2) AS coverage_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_farrans_endpoints;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_HOST.name: VW_HOSTS_OS_DISTRIBUTION
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_HOST.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_hosts_os_distribution

AS
SELECT
    COALESCE(a.os, 'UNKNOWN') AS operating_system,
    a.bu,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.asset_id) AS asset_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.asset_id) AS scanned_assets,
    AVG(DATEDIFF('day', a.last_activity, CURRENT_DATE())) AS avg_days_inactive,
    COUNT_IF(s.scan_date >= DATEADD('day', -30, CURRENT_DATE())) AS scanned_last_30d,
    ROUND(scanned_last_30d * 100.0 / asset_count, 2) AS scan_coverage_pct,
    MAX(a.last_activity) AS most_recent_activity
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_host_assets a
LEFT JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_scan_events s 
    ON a.asset_id = s.asset_id
GROUP BY operating_system, a.bu;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SOPH.name: VW_SOPHOS_SECURITY_ALERTS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SOPH.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_sophos_security_alerts

AS
SELECT
    alert_type,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS affected_endpoints,
    MAX(CASE 
            WHEN alert_type = 'UNHEALTHY_ENDPOINT' THEN 'Critical'
            WHEN alert_type = 'INACTIVE_ENDPOINT' THEN 'High'
            ELSE 'Medium' 
        END) AS severity,
    AVG(DATEDIFF('day', last_active, CURRENT_DATE())) AS avg_days_inactive,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_sophos_security_alerts
GROUP BY alert_type;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_AV_C.name: VW_AV_CURRENT_EDR_COMPLIANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_AV_C.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_av_current_edr_compliance

AS
SELECT
    f.opco_name,
    o.region,  -- Corregido: tomado de dim_av_opco
    f.report_month,
    f.av_installed_pct * 100 AS edr_coverage_pct,
    ROUND((f.av_installed_pct - 0.98) * 100, 2) AS gap_to_target_pct,
    CASE
        WHEN f.av_installed_pct >= 0.98 THEN 'Compliant'
        WHEN f.av_installed_pct >= 0.95 THEN 'Warning'
        ELSE 'Non-Compliant'
    END AS compliance_status,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() AS snapshot_ts
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_av_health f
JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_av_opco o  -- Añadido JOIN necesario
    ON f.opco_name = o.opco_name
WHERE f.report_month = (SELECT MAX(report_month) FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_av_health);

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_BITS.name: VW_BITSIGHT_VENDOR_RISK
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_BITS.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_bitsight_vendor_risk

AS
SELECT
    domain_name,
    COUNT_IF(severity = 'CRITICAL') AS critical_findings,
    COUNT_IF(severity = 'HIGH') AS high_findings,
    COUNT_IF(severity = 'MEDIUM') AS medium_findings,
    MAX(last_seen) AS last_finding_date,
    CASE
        WHEN critical_findings > 0 THEN 'HIGH'
        WHEN high_findings > 0 THEN 'MEDIUM'
        ELSE 'LOW'
    END AS risk_rating,
    CASE
        WHEN risk_rating IN ('HIGH', 'MEDIUM') THEN 'ABOVE_TARGET'
        ELSE 'WITHIN_TARGET'
    END AS target_status
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_bitsight_findings
GROUP BY domain_name;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_HOST.name: VW_HOSTS_COMPLIANCE_THRESHOLDS

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SENT.name: VW_SENTINEL_AGENT_COMPLIANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SENT.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_sentinel_agent_compliance

AS
SELECT
    agent_version,
    MIN(version_release_date) AS version_release_date,
    COUNT(*) AS endpoint_count,
    COUNT_IF(update_status) AS updated_count,
    COUNT_IF(NOT update_status) AS outdated_count,
    COUNT_IF(last_active >= DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_DATE())) AS active_count,
    ROUND(outdated_count * 100.0 / endpoint_count, 2) AS outdated_pct,
    MAX(DATEDIFF('day', last_active, CURRENT_DATE())) AS max_days_inactive,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_sentinel_endpoints
GROUP BY agent_version;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_STAL.name: VW_STALE_INVENTORY_ALERTS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_STAL.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_stale_inventory_alerts

AS
SELECT
    computer_name,
    organisation,
    most_frequent_user,
    operating_system,
    last_scanned,
    DATEDIFF('day', last_scanned, CURRENT_DATE()) AS days_since_scan,
    status,
    CASE
        WHEN status = 'Inactive' AND days_since_scan > 90 THEN 'Retirement Candidate'
        WHEN days_since_scan > 60 THEN 'Needs Rescan'
        WHEN status = 'Active' AND days_since_scan > 30 THEN 'Scan Overdue'
        ELSE 'Within Policy'
    END AS alert_severity
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_hardware_inventory
WHERE alert_severity != 'Within Policy';

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ZSCA.name: VW_ZSCALER_ANALYSIS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ZSCA.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_ZSCALER_ANALYSIS AS

-- Simple, efficient view focusing on Zscaler threat data with device context
SELECT
    -- Threat information
    t.THREAT_NAME,
    t.THREAT_CATEGORY,
    t.THREAT_CLASS,
    t.REASON,
    t.THREAT,
    t.DATE_SEEN,
    t.DOMAIN,
    t.USER,
    t.CLIENT_IP,
    t.DEVICE_HOSTNAME,
    
    -- Enhanced threat categorization
    CASE
        WHEN t.THREAT_CLASS = 'Advanced Threat Protection' THEN 'ATP'
        WHEN t.THREAT_CLASS = 'Anti Virus' THEN 'AV'
        ELSE t.THREAT_CLASS
    END AS THREAT_CLASS_SHORT,
    
    -- Simplified threat severity
    CASE
        WHEN CONTAINS(t.THREAT_CLASS, 'Critical') OR CONTAINS(t.REASON, 'Critical') THEN 'Critical'
        WHEN CONTAINS(t.THREAT_CLASS, 'High') OR CONTAINS(t.REASON, 'High') THEN 'High'
        WHEN CONTAINS(t.THREAT_CLASS, 'Medium') OR CONTAINS(t.REASON, 'Medium') THEN 'Medium'
        WHEN CONTAINS(t.THREAT_CLASS, 'Low') OR CONTAINS(t.REASON, 'Low') THEN 'Low'
        ELSE 'Info'
    END AS SEVERITY,
    
    -- Device information via LEFT JOIN
    d.DEVICE_TYPE,
    d.OS_VERSION,
    d.ZSCALER_CLIENT_CONNECTOR_VERSION,
    d.DEVICE_STATE,
    d.MANUFACTURER,
    d.COMPANY_NAME,
    d.DEVICE_TRUST_LEVEL
    
FROM 
    DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.ZSCALER_DAILY_THREATS t
LEFT JOIN 
    DEV_LANDING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.ZSCALAR d
    ON (t.USER = d.USER AND t.DEVICE_HOSTNAME = d.HOSTNAME)
;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CYBE.name: VW_CYBELANGEL_REMEDIATION_PERFORMANCE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_CYBE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_cybelangel_remediation_performance

AS
WITH resolved_alerts AS (
    SELECT
        a.incident_id,
        a.detection_date,
        a.status_checking_date AS resolution_date,
        DATEDIFF('days', a.detection_date, a.status_checking_date) AS days_to_resolve,
        t.threat_type,
        a.severity
    FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_cybelangel_alerts a
    JOIN DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_cybelangel_threats t 
        ON a.alert_key = t.alert_key
    WHERE a.status IN ('resolved')
)
SELECT
    threat_type,
    severity,
    COUNT(*) AS resolved_count,
    ROUND(AVG(days_to_resolve), 1) AS avg_resolution_days,
    ROUND(MEDIAN(days_to_resolve), 1) AS median_resolution_days,
    MAX(days_to_resolve) AS max_resolution_days,
    COUNT_IF(days_to_resolve <= 7) AS within_sla_7d,
    COUNT_IF(days_to_resolve > 7 AND days_to_resolve <= 14) AS within_sla_14d,
    COUNT_IF(days_to_resolve > 14) AS breached_sla
FROM resolved_alerts
GROUP BY threat_type, severity;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_DEFE.name: VW_DEFENDER_RESPONSE_METRICS
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_DEFE.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_defender_response_metrics

AS
WITH threat_data AS (
    SELECT
        threat_id,
        device_id,
        threat_date,
        threat_type,
        LEAD(threat_date) OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY threat_date) AS next_threat_date
    FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_defender_threats
)
SELECT
    threat_type,
    COUNT(*) AS threat_count,
    AVG(DATEDIFF('minutes', threat_date, next_threat_date)) AS avg_response_minutes,
    MEDIAN(DATEDIFF('minutes', threat_date, next_threat_date)) AS median_response_minutes,
    MAX(DATEDIFF('minutes', threat_date, next_threat_date)) AS max_response_minutes
FROM threat_data
WHERE next_threat_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY threat_type;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SENT.name: VW_SENTINEL_EDR_COVERAGE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SENT.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_sentinel_edr_coverage

AS
SELECT
    'ALL_ENDPOINTS' AS scope,
    COUNT(*) AS total_endpoints,
    COUNT_IF(update_status) AS updated_agents,
    COUNT_IF(last_active >= DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_DATE())) AS active_7d,
    COUNT_IF(device_type = 'Server') AS servers,
    COUNT_IF(device_type = 'Workstation') AS workstations,
    ROUND(updated_agents * 100.0 / total_endpoints, 2) AS update_compliance_pct,
    ROUND(active_7d * 100.0 / total_endpoints, 2) AS active_coverage_pct,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.fact_sentinel_endpoints;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLU.name: VW_SPLUNK_LOG_COVERAGE
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_SPLU.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_splunk_log_coverage

AS
SELECT
    opco,
    COUNT(*) AS total_hosts,
    COUNT_IF(last_seen >= DATEADD(day, -1, CURRENT_DATE())) AS active_1d,
    COUNT_IF(last_seen >= DATEADD(day, -7, CURRENT_DATE())) AS active_7d,
    COUNT_IF(last_seen >= DATEADD(day, -30, CURRENT_DATE())) AS active_30d,
    ROUND(active_1d * 100.0 / total_hosts, 2) AS coverage_1d_pct,
    ROUND(active_7d * 100.0 / total_hosts, 2) AS coverage_7d_pct,
    ROUND(active_30d * 100.0 / total_hosts, 2) AS coverage_30d_pct,
    COUNT_IF(last_seen < DATEADD(day, -90, CURRENT_DATE())) AS stale_hosts,
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.dim_splunk_hosts
GROUP BY opco;

DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_QUAL.name: VW_QUALYS_VULNERABILITY_SUMMARY
DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.VW_QUAL.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW DEV_REPORTING.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.vw_qualys_vulnerability_summary

AS
SELECT
    severity_level,
    CASE severity_level
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Informational'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Low'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Medium'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'High'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Critical'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
    END AS severity_name,
    COUNT(*) AS vuln_count,
    COUNT_IF(patchable) AS patchable_vulns,
    COUNT_IF(exploitable) AS exploitable_vulns,
    COUNT_IF(pci_flag) AS pci_vulns,
    AVG(cvss_v3_base) AS avg_cvss_score,
    MIN(published_datetime) AS oldest_vuln,
    MAX(published_datetime) AS newest_vuln,
    COUNT_IF(DATEDIFF('day', published_datetime, CURRENT_DATE()) > 365) AS legacy_vulns, -- Corrección aquí
    CURRENT_DATE() AS snapshot_date
FROM DEV_TRANSFORMATION.SECURITY_ANALYTICS.qualys_vuln_kb_data
GROUP BY severity_level;
